body:
Opponents of voting rights in Georgia are willing to go to any length to make sure they gain more power and control. We must make sure voters know to vote early and turn out in this crucial election for our democracy.
RUSH $25 or more right now to help educate and turn out pro-democracy voters in Georgia and beyond! >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=092624_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=092624_3&amount=25]
Georgia Public Broadcasting: State Election Board passes new rule ordering hand count of ballots. Election officials aren't happy [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=092624_3&amount=25]
In case you missed the news, Team:
" Georgia’s State Election Board passed arguably the most contentious of the new rules it had been considering for conducting elections in the state over the objections of county-level election directors and over the advice of Georgia Attorney General Chris Carr. "
You read that right -- over the objections of the officials who run our elections here in Georgia, even including Republican state AG Chris Car and Republican Georgia Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger -- three MAGA-aligned members of the State Election Board approved the rule mandating a hand count of paper ballots at the close of polls at every poll site, before the actual tabulation of votes or before even submitting them to county election heads.
The MAGA acolytes running the board didn't care that their rule change within the 90 days before an election violates federal law. They didn't care that the Attorney General of the state, a member of their own party, said their move wasn't supported by any of Georgia's election laws, suppressive or otherwise. They didn't care that their moves overstepped the legal authority of their board either. They had their marching orders as election deniers and wanted to take every step possible to ensure chaos on Election Day.
So what can we do? if you live in Georgia, vote early or by mail ahead of Election Day to make sure your ballot doesn't get lost in the melee. If you don't live in Georgia but have friends or family who do, encourage them to vote early however they can. If you’re like most conservatives, you get endless emails and text messages from candidates asking for money. _But how do you know if they are actually conservative and not just pretending?_ _How do you know if they even have a chance of winning?_ _How do you know if costly fundraising commissions and processing fees will consume most of your contribution?_ These are all important questions that everyone must ask if they want to be effective with their political contributions. **The Senate Conservatives Fund is one of the best ways to make your contributions count.** We do it by providing grassroots conservatives like you with a trusted list of candidates who are strong, viable conservatives. Every SCF-endorsed candidate must undergo a vetting process to help us determine whether they share our principles and values and, more importantly, will actually fight for them after the election. Every candidate must also run a professional campaign capable of winning. But creating a list of conservative candidates is just the beginning; we also give you an _**[_**effective way to fund their campaigns!**_](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=b2b32020568141219d810c0c0a9f2313&_e=bSi6lngBjiLs4zAUDmuyU1q6TgFyX9b6jRRohf3JpaV9PhcoZFCUdjkCUHerb4dnOziN1JYn_Vz3JFc4CUtMHNGs5sHv_rrhOzz0x3jmKmEd-ikqTJezIUdMSXEQl92RbKb9kinCwNWyMzyA0lCaIOwFchDsSydCBsdO301f3Gb0jjozUHj4a3rz0NK43G5nibgpJMXnjrxi8rsBcXkmFrweEjuZ81ox0uzHPIT2FWc%3D)**_ The best way to support a candidate financially is to donate to their campaigns. Once you move away from the candidate’s campaign — whether it be a party committee, joint-fundraising committee, PAC, or other organization — your contribution's effectiveness declines. However, donating to multiple candidates can be complicated and time-consuming, and there could be hidden fees and expenses that make this less beneficial to the candidates. **That's why SCF allows you to donate to multiple candidates with one payment and why SCF pays all fundraising expenses related to those contributions.** _This saves candidates a ton of money._ As you know, processing fees are charged for all online transactions. What you probably don’t know is that candidates also often pay steep fundraising commissions to third-party vendors, which are at least 80% of the value of your contribution. Candidates have to pay outside vendors to help them find new donors across the country, and this service is quite expensive. **That means that when you get an email or text message from a candidate and click on the link to donate $100 to that candidate, the candidate will often get less than $20 after expenses.** This is why you should [**donate to candidates through SCF**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=b2b32020568141219d810c0c0a9f2313&_e=bSi6lngBjiLs4zAUDmuyU1q6TgFyX9b6jRRohf3JpaV9PhcoZFCUdjkCUHerb4dnOziN1JYn_Vz3JFc4CUtMHC_htHzcHHzkvCRccamyAYU8akxWZH9Cf6hwl5SxpiS-orxSsv6O8QxCwQQaJMMPx2U287nM3BGH4wAy709LD8R9qO2S0Za9-D89wGoaVrK3R7_uOO-WksGzQ-AO72r_vZH4cWu6dan-ekr7LX1jgsw%3D) whenever possible. It’s one of the only ways to guarantee that the candidate will get 100% of your contribution with no hidden fees or expenses. And if you like our work and want to help us do more to promote good candidates, you can also contribute to SCF, which is our general fund. This will help us mobilize other patriots like you to help elect strong conservative leaders.

**2024 Senate Candidates**

Here’s the list of Senate candidates we are supporting this year — three incumbents and five challengers. ▶︎ Sen. Ted Cruz (TX) ▶︎ Sen. Rick Scott (FL)
▶︎ Sen. Josh Hawley (MO)
▶︎ Bernie Moreno (OH)

But how do you know if they are actually conservative and not just pretending? How do you know if they even have a chance of winning? How do you know if costly fundraising commissions and processing fees will consume most of your contribution? These are all important questions that everyone must ask if they want to be effective with their political contributions. The Senate Conservatives Fund is one of the best ways to make your contributions count. We do it by providing grassroots conservatives like you with a trusted list of candidates who are strong, viable conservatives. Every SCF-endorsed candidate must undergo a vetting process to help us determine whether they share our principles and values and, more importantly, will actually fight for them after the election. Every candidate must also run a professional campaign capable of winning. But creating a list of conservative candidates is just the beginning; we also give you an The best way to support a candidate financially is to donate to their campaigns. Once you move away from the candidate’s campaign — whether it be a party committee, joint-fundraising committee, PAC, or other organization — your contribution's effectiveness declines. However, donating to multiple candidates can be complicated and time-consuming, and there could be hidden fees and expenses that make this less beneficial to the candidates. That's why SCF allows you to donate to multiple candidates with one payment and why SCF pays all fundraising expenses related to those contributions. This saves candidates a ton of money. As you know, processing fees are charged for all online transactions. What you probably don’t know is that candidates also often pay steep fundraising commissions to third-party vendors, which are at least 80% of the value of your contribution. Candidates have to pay outside vendors to help them find new donors across the country, and this service is quite expensive. That means that when you get an email or text message from a candidate and click on the link to donate $100 to that candidate, the candidate will often get less than $20 after expenses. This is why you should whenever possible. It’s one of the only ways to guarantee that the candidate will get 100% of your contribution with no hidden fees or expenses. And if you like our work and want to help us do more to promote good candidates, you can also contribute to SCF, which is our general fund. name: John Repke for Montana State Auditor 2024
subject: You up?
body:
We need to talk. | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/4fa71b362495/we-need-a-montana-state-auditor-who-you-can-trust-7226419?e=9ec0a0596f)
---
| | | | |
#
---
| I know it’s late. But this is important.
[**I need your help to lower the price of insurance in Montana while guaranteeing access to high-quality insurance that is reliable, consistent, and doesn’t disappear when you need it.**](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=c4b07ec801&e=9ec0a0596f)
I’m sure if you’re anything like me, you know that insurance prices can really make your pocket hurt.
The insurance market in our state is changing – and not for the better. Montanans seeking insurance are having an increasingly tough time obtaining insurance or avoiding cancellation. And when they can get insurance, they are seeing skyrocketing rates in all areas - health, auto, home.

---
[](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=bd8afd7f55&e=9ec0a0596f)
| But insurance isn’t a luxury. You can’t drive to work without auto insurance, you can’t buy a house without home insurance (and if you rent, you’re paying your landlord’s home insurance in your monthly rent bill), and you’re at risk of serious health outcomes -- or even bankruptcy -- if you lack adequate health insurance.
The bottom line: insurance is necessary, but it’s increasingly harder to get and it keeps getting more expensive.
---
[ACT NOW](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=8a8c837b26&e=9ec0a0596f)
| The most important responsibility of the State Auditor is to ensure Montana families and businesses have access to reliable insurance at fair rates.
[**If we work together, we can bring costs down, and make us all better off in the process.**](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=dca7f6874a&e=9ec0a0596f)
Montana deserves a State Auditor who is trustworthy and dedicated to the job. I will get the job done right.
Can I count on your vote?
**Best,**
---

CA Democrats,
MANY of the most flippable Republican seats are districts with sizable Latino populations, particularly within the Central Valley:

name: Kamala Harris
subject: An ironing board, a roll of duct tape, and some signs
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Harris for President
body:
Peter, when I ran my first race -- for District Attorney in San Fransisco -- I took two things with me everywhere I went. | | |
---
Peter, when I ran my first race -- for District Attorney in San Fransisco -- I took three things with me everywhere I went: An ironing board, a roll of duct tape, and a sign that read: _"Kamala Harris, a voice for justice."_ It wasn't glamorous, but it was the perfect setup for getting my message out to voters in front of grocery stores, bus stops, and more. Perhaps, most importantly: _It worked._ That November, I was elected for the very first time. Running for President of the United States is a _bit_ different. Our movement is bigger, we need to reach many more voters across the country, and we’ve certainly upgraded from an ironing board to get out our message. **Two things remain the same: I am still fighting For The People, and I still need grassroots supporters like you by my side to win.** Right now, Donald Trump and his allies are spending millions of dollars on attack ads against me, and the latest polling shows this race is statistically tied. I will continue criss-crossing the country to reach voters -- and that requires significant resources, Peter. Our race is a must-win for Democrats to take back the House. What happens in our swing district will decide whether Democrats win the majority or MAGA extremists stay in control. If we lose here, we hand Mike Johnson and Marjorie Taylor Greene the Speaker’s gavel for another two years. It’s safe to say the stakes have never been higher. And there’s no more time - ballots are mailed out next week! We have to be running at full steam ahead to lock in as many of these voters as possible. Unfortunately, Republicans are spending millions of dollars against us and their ads are running at maximum overdrive (thanks to Elon Musk’s donations...) I need your grassroots support right now to keep our ads on the air and fight back — because every single vote matters. The last poll between me and my MAGA opponent, Kevin Lincoln, showed me down by 1 point. name: Clint St. Mosley for Congress
subject: Clint St. Mosley: Update from Michigan's 9th Congressional District
body:
Clint St. Mosley Campaign Update from Michigan's 9th Congressional District | | | | |
---
|
# Greetings from the Campaign Trail!
---
| | | | | Hello everyone and thank you for supporting our campaign!
With just 41 days to go, this is likely to be the one of most consequential weeks of our campaign as more than 115,000 absentee ballots will be mailed out to voters across the 9th Congressional District in the coming days.
Because of the importance of reaching them, we’ve launched an all-out blitz that includes digital and social media ads targeted to likely AV voters and amped-up canvassing that starts this Saturday across the district.
And our order of 1,000 more signs has arrived!
We also hired a field operations director, Tom Cruz, who is helping us organize canvassing, phone/text banking and precinct delegate volunteers. (And may be repelling from a helicopter along the way!)
So if you’d like to volunteer to help put end to Lisa McClains’ MAGA Madness and restore civility in Washington, sign up [**HERE**](https://clint4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e73040a2243d332c2516e1117&id=3dbd8c4a81&e=21c900a6be)! We’ll connect you with Tom to help get you going a.s.a.p.
While we’re feeling good on these fronts, we’re still behind our targets to get campaign lit mailed to these voters. At nearly $1 each across 85,000 AV addresses, this is one of our largest expenses of the campaign and remains an uphill battle.
[**CLICK HERE**](https://clint4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e73040a2243d332c2516e1117&id=7ee181651e&e=21c900a6be) if this is something you can help us cover.
**Student Absentee Voters** On the topic of AV/mail-in voters, one group vital to Democrats are young voters and college students. The good news is, Michigan has among the highest percentage of registered voters ages 18-25 in the U.S.
The bad news: this group tends to have the lowest voter turnout of any age group.
Parents, please make a plan to get your kids a mail-in ballot and get it to them. Remind them to vote _and_ fill out the ballot on both sides. Reach out to your local Dem club for slate cards if you need them.
**Trickle-Down Economics is DOA** When out canvassing, let’s remember that Democrats have a strong economic story to tell undecided voters. Without getting into the weeds here’s where we win:
First, Trickle-Down Economics has been a complete disaster for working class families since Reagan rolled it out over 40 years ago. All it did was turn millionaires into billionaires, and destroyed the middle class while helping put our country in massive debt.
Democrats are focusing on the Opportunity Economy that prioritizes working families first by growing our economy from the bottom up, and middle out. That’s what the Biden/Harris administration has done with investments in infrastructure, the CHIPs and Science Act and the Inflation Reduction Act.
All of these programs are why manufacturing jobs in Michigan are at record highs and wages are up while unemployment remains historically low.
I also often hear from voters that Joe Biden caused inflation. That again, is not true. Inflation began during Covid due to supply chain interruptions and labor shortages. However, under Biden and Harris, America tamped-down inflation FASTER than any other country.
And once again, America is the LARGEST economy in the world! Plus the stock market is up, growth is strong and we avoided the recession that many predicted.
Now that inflation is in-check, interest rates are coming down, and so too are the costs of goods and housing. Yes, we’ve got a lot more to do, but let’s stand strong on the economic gains Democrats have delivered to working families.
**On the Campaign Trail** I had an awesome time at the St. Clair County Democratic Party Fall Solidarity Brunch at the St. Clair Inn. It was an amazing event with guest speakers Rep. David Bonior (ret.) and Kyra Harris Bolden, who is running for the Michigan Supreme Court.
My thanks to SCCDP chair Jim Frank and the event committee for allowing me to speak and for organizing one of the best group of Democrats I’ve seen in a long time!
**Upcoming Events****9/30 Caseville** : Thumb Brewery Meet & Greet on Monday, Sept. 30 from 5-7 p.m., at 6758 Pine St, Caseville, MI, United States, Michigan[ _**EVENT LINK**_](https://clint4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e73040a2243d332c2516e1117&id=7597125b90&e=21c900a6be)
**10/4 Holly** : Holly Fundraiser for Clint St. Mosley 4Congress, Friday, Oct. 4 from 5:30-7 p.m. at Funky Fungi’s Tea House, 113 Battle Aly, Holly, MI. [_**EVENT LINK**_](https://clint4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e73040a2243d332c2516e1117&id=0982a70517&e=21c900a6be)
_If you’d like to host or organize an event in your area, please reach out Sara DiGiglio at_[ _sara@clint4congress.com_](mailto:sara@clint4congress.com) _and she’ll help get you get things going._
If you have questions or would like to discuss issues important to you, contact me at [hello@clint4congress.com](mailto:hello@clint4congress.com) and we’ll connect.
Again, as always, I am eternally grateful for all the help and support you’ve given our campaign. As every day passes, we meet more enthusiastic supporters who are energized by the Harris/Walz ticket and are motivated to bring the positive change we need for our district in November!
Sincerely,
Clint St. MosleyDemocratic CandidateMichigan’s 9th Congressional District
[**LINK TO DONATE TO OUR CAMPAIGN**](https://clint4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e73040a2243d332c2516e1117&id=fca26b08eb&e=21c900a6be)

# It's time to reclaim our democracy.

The Citizens United ruling opened the floodgates for unlimited corporate spending in our elections. Since then, billionaires and special interests have gained outsized influence over our political system, drowning out the voices of everyday Americans. We need to overturn Citizens United and put an end to the idea that corporations are people with the same rights as individuals. Our elections should reflect the will of the people—not the wallets of the wealthiest few.
Let’s stand together for real campaign finance reform, transparency, and a political system where everyone has an equal voice. It’s time to make our democracy work for all of us again.

He’s spent his time in office pushing some of the most dangerous conspiracy theories and hateful rhetoric imaginable.

Cruz led the charge to overturn the 2020 election results and fueled the fire for the January 6 attack on our Capitol. **And he's already signaled that he's not going to accept this year's election results if he doesn’t like the outcome.**

Texas is better than Ted Cruz, and we finally have the candidate who can beat him and give Texans the leadership they deserve.

Colin Allred is the real deal – he’s taken on and defeated an entrenched Republican incumbent like Cruz, even when experts said it was impossible.

I know we can finally kick him to the curb and elect Colin, but we need to make sure his campaign has the resources to contact undecided voters across Texas. **Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's hear.com's **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **hear.com's IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z0narmaphe619o458lcba8cbqlnmhggrhhbjnlj0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c5j60pj6c3h2bs)

What makes hear.com’s IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that hear.com’s IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains hear.com founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's hear.com's **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

What makes hear.com’s IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that hear.com’s IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains hear.com founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlca5dcedd0c76o8k563cqfhllm37863pe9e3bkg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c5j68oj1clh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American,

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zc2otlqpnvm4s2qtdvbh5e14sg19l127kk8vldr0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c5j68oj1clh2bs)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1gq9qbe662s62o54q89vpnp5f9rfa39o0t7ald0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c5j68oj1clh2bs)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvll7qoglk9s0otv7frhppim523tk4j6ovj6qmso_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c5j68oj1clh2bs)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection. By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below: For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty. This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include: Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;" Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty; Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people; Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers. Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future. So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below: And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. body:
Tim is fighting an uphill battle against a career politician who will spend hundreds of millions to cling to power and continue to work against the interests of the people of Montana.

Fellow Conservative,

It's Ted Cruz.

You know me.

You know I'm a freedom fighter, a defender of liberty, and an advocate for a smaller, more effective federal government.

You probably don't know this man, former U.S. Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy; you should familiarize yourself with his name and mission to be Montana's next United States Senator.

******************************************************[Chip in any amount ->](http://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zk67ilqpifv14pv33ru3s7d9t0cthkbt7p0k4gqg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c5j62o71clh2bs)******************************************************

If Republicans do not do everything in our power to help Tim Sheehy defeat Jon Tester in Montana, we will not be able to capture the Senate majority in November.

That's just a fact.

While I'm grateful that conservatives like you open emails like this one, I'd be even more thankful if you took the next step and made a financial contribution to Tim Sheehy's U.S. Senate campaign right now.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](http://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z9ii7ing0nrs0u32m99fho11ksuceiouu3g2c14o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c5j62o71clh2bs)******************************************************

Not ready to donate yet? Ok, Here are a couple of reasons I'm PROUD to endorse Tim Sheehy in what is shaping up to be a VERY costly and VERY competitive Senate race in Montana. Generational change: Tim's opponent is running for a FOURTH six-year term in the Senate. What can Jon Tester do with another six years in the Senate that he couldn't accomplish in the previous 18?

Transparency: As far as I'm aware, few Americans support elected officials beholden to lobbyists and special interest groups. Tim's opponent is the largest recipient of lobbyist dollars in the United States Senate.

Service: As a former Navy SEAL and recipient of a Purple Heart and Bronze Star medal, Tim truly knows what it means to put his country first. Veterans make the best public servants; bravery and honor are not things someone can teach.

Tim's race in Montana will likely be one of, if not the most expensive, Senate races this year. When I tell you that you cannot afford to refrain from contributing to this American Hero, I mean it.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](http://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zm05dg1ucet2ntgr2jeckbfhjn37ds8cgqjc6c48_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c5j62o71clh2bs)******************************************************

If you want more of the same, then by all means, ignore me, this email, and my request for your assistance.

But having been in the Senate for several years now, I know a couple of things to be true: Democrats cannot do the math. They have no concept of money, what it costs the average American to live, or how to balance a budget. Spending more than you make is a recipe for DISASTER.

Democrats don't understand geography. Despite countless Republican efforts to help them understand the concept of borders, they can't seem to grasp the idea of national sovereignty. Heck, since Joe Biden moved into the White House in 2021, more than 10 million illegal migrants have crossed our "border" illegally.

Democrats fail to understand that religious zealots want us all DEAD. From calling for cease-fires with terrorists to sending money to Iran in exchange for nothing but lies, Democrats have zero concept of what peace through strength means.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](http://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z0gds6mb3q1hluag7nntvrnka9q9fat0jt99ojt0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c5j62o71clh2bs)******************************************************

As you know, I am running for re-election to the Senate this year and can speak with some authority about what Americans seek in a leader. Tim Sheehy is already a leader, and now I need your help to make him a leader in the United States Senate.

I hope you'll stand with me today in support of this great American, former Navy SEAL, and future United States Senator, Tim Sheehy.

Respectfully,

Ted Cruz

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z8utidmuvaqb213frl8i7m66g220mnkn6vsnacro_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c5j62o76cjh2bs) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com's](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z51fhkafcjdco9geclt8jcu35l69tqqgl9m441c8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c5j62o76cjh2bs) IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z9gmtauc15fo7stq87upmrtci1vl5f9h2e8083vg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c5j62o76cjh2bs)
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2n9s2380bbi04rso6s1htbm9qlvcme0iv8nocvo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c5j62o76cjh2bs)
What makes [hear.com's](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z37bd0jietnrnkoa1ok4tc4283f9prk69c7mecuo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c5j62o76cjh2bs) IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com's](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zgf7d7mse04esmqvvhk10f877vskmnqhr762ensg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c5j62o76cjh2bs) IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains [hear.com's](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z5olnoicjrjgt563s2njjvpup4hn7kg024im5018_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c5j62o76cjh2bs) founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ti_ZBfYN4BJjOqEoCiblxA~~/AARclAA~)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American,

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ti_ZBfYN4BJjOqEoCiblxA~~/AARclAA~)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ti_ZBfYN4BJjOqEoCiblxA~~/AARclAA~)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ti_ZBfYN4BJjOqEoCiblxA~~/AARclAA~)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Restore Our Nation

body:
Tim is fighting an uphill battle against a career politician who will spend hundreds of millions to cling to power and continue to work against the interests of the people of Montana.

Fellow Conservative,

It's Ted Cruz.

You know me.

You know I'm a freedom fighter, a defender of liberty, and an advocate for a smaller, more effective federal government.

You probably don't know this man, former U.S. Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy; you should familiarize yourself with his name and mission to be Montana's next United States Senator.

******************************************************[Chip in any amount ->](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/wRkN1-Ydw3iuq2wiZ14sPQ~~/AARclAA~)******************************************************

If Republicans do not do everything in our power to help Tim Sheehy defeat Jon Tester in Montana, we will not be able to capture the Senate majority in November.

That's just a fact.

While I'm grateful that conservatives like you open emails like this one, I'd be even more thankful if you took the next step and made a financial contribution to Tim Sheehy's U.S. Senate campaign right now.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/wRkN1-Ydw3iuq2wiZ14sPQ~~/AARclAA~)******************************************************

Not ready to donate yet? Ok, Here are a couple of reasons I'm PROUD to endorse Tim Sheehy in what is shaping up to be a VERY costly and VERY competitive Senate race in Montana. Generational change: Tim's opponent is running for a FOURTH six-year term in the Senate. What can Jon Tester do with another six years in the Senate that he couldn't accomplish in the previous 18?

Transparency: As far as I'm aware, few Americans support elected officials beholden to lobbyists and special interest groups. Tim's opponent is the largest recipient of lobbyist dollars in the United States Senate.

Service: As a former Navy SEAL and recipient of a Purple Heart and Bronze Star medal, Tim truly knows what it means to put his country first. Veterans make the best public servants; bravery and honor are not things someone can teach.

Tim's race in Montana will likely be one of, if not the most expensive, Senate races this year. When I tell you that you cannot afford to refrain from contributing to this American Hero, I mean it.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/wRkN1-Ydw3iuq2wiZ14sPQ~~/AARclAA~)******************************************************

If you want more of the same, then by all means, ignore me, this email, and my request for your assistance.

But having been in the Senate for several years now, I know a couple of things to be true: Democrats cannot do the math. They have no concept of money, what it costs the average American to live, or how to balance a budget. Spending more than you make is a recipe for DISASTER.

Democrats don't understand geography. Despite countless Republican efforts to help them understand the concept of borders, they can't seem to grasp the idea of national sovereignty. Heck, since Joe Biden moved into the White House in 2021, more than 10 million illegal migrants have crossed our "border" illegally.

Democrats fail to understand that religious zealots want us all DEAD. From calling for cease-fires with terrorists to sending money to Iran in exchange for nothing but lies, Democrats have zero concept of what peace through strength means.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/wRkN1-Ydw3iuq2wiZ14sPQ~~/AARclAA~)******************************************************

As you know, I am running for re-election to the Senate this year and can speak with some authority about what Americans seek in a leader. Tim Sheehy is already a leader, and now I need your help to make him a leader in the United States Senate.

I hope you'll stand with me today in support of this great American, former Navy SEAL, and future United States Senator, Tim Sheehy.

Respectfully,

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/wRkN1-Ydw3iuq2wiZ14sPQ~~/AARclAA~)
Ted Cruz

Dear Fellow American,

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=04ebaa080922470fa28d9a6fa2ef9826&_e=MvfgsL2Cv_lr4VeEiY9E7cY7e__EC9lDKFRsFo_0UsfkBXGwXl2lLaqVJmdMUYptSv62guJ7O3JRxaLz3Noo7PuwyqzCi54rq8adew4FFXUTVoeNcAIkniEdwb0zKVxJSqTu9NLD7WgutyGhi7VsK4HL1_n2P9XOq22MLOebC57wp38mqrgFa4jjUvvpKl35hqhpS0FN6JPYmu9NpVUJhZoXA8BaxRLHNYy6dBCB0Efoq0Qn1zgVNZeJYeuPAGrx7AMHmoj9CzV_OvZ2dY8p7EhDlFw--vhFPsJ2TB-2KmcjjnJ-YsjIlxpJQNKRWZV7Mq_JpqEQRw1dsKRko0xxu0fAxkp5BW6h84J5eu74Li3kXGqDeZ7Fa9Xj2cirofpontOP_XBFq-vAWagfvcNuqTso-F4BB0pg30dTfWLh5lA%3D)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=04ebaa080922470fa28d9a6fa2ef9826&_e=MvfgsL2Cv_lr4VeEiY9E7cY7e__EC9lDKFRsFo_0UsfkBXGwXl2lLaqVJmdMUYptSv62guJ7O3JRxaLz3Noo7PuwyqzCi54rq8adew4FFXUTVoeNcAIkniEdwb0zKVxJSqTu9NLD7WgutyGhi7VsK4HL1_n2P9XOq22MLOebC57wp38mqrgFa4jjUvvpKl35hqhpS0FN6JPYmu9NpVUJhZoXA8BaxRLHNYy6dBCB0Efoq0Qn1zgVNZeJYeuPAGrx7AMHmoj9CzV_OvZ2dY8p7CYPBPNCMjCRbHPCHkE044mxypvhW8eIlrfuUxc2lF832t1KNCgNRRbqEOqzUWWSgQG7jCt3lojoUC5fVeT2Gpidwhzmsdybw9U1Y_N9jMndckXpA2qxNKaNp4ngWNX207A_DH9M2Hm7P3h7i0AMPT4%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=04ebaa080922470fa28d9a6fa2ef9826&_e=MvfgsL2Cv_lr4VeEiY9E7cY7e__EC9lDKFRsFo_0UsfkBXGwXl2lLaqVJmdMUYptSv62guJ7O3JRxaLz3Noo7PuwyqzCi54rq8adew4FFXUTVoeNcAIkniEdwb0zKVxJSqTu9NLD7WgutyGhi7VsK4HL1_n2P9XOq22MLOebC57wp38mqrgFa4jjUvvpKl35hqhpS0FN6JPYmu9NpVUJhZoXA8BaxRLHNYy6dBCB0Efoq0Qn1zgVNZeJYeuPAGrx7AMHmoj9CzV_OvZ2dY8p7ApWNT6VsKfeZZKyWpm0VuPVC4v3Pwzt8asijhVmQhzBywm8RlanmBXwORHCBLcfhG9-deLrjXhH1CSbfw0P8aOYUZ6qxC7lgiEeF2MAwTP0elocc6mYLku65a-1X8bL8tHPcTU7jolH7FMI1_32Cn0%3D)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below: For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty. This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include: Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;" Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty; Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people; Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers. Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future. So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below: And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. | | | | A lot of folks probably don’t know this, folks, but Kamala Harris and I actually go way back. Both of us came up in public service as district attorneys, and over the last decade, we’ve fought hard to protect our communities and provide opportunities for all families. She’s been a mentor and friend for more than 14 years, and our relationship has helped shape how I view public service. I often refer to her as “ _my quintessential big sister_ ,” because she has always shown up for me when I needed her. In fact, when I first won my race to become Prince George’s County Executive, one of the first calls I received was from her. I’d like to share one piece of advice that she shared with me: _More important than being first at something is to make sure you are not the last._ And now that we’re standing on the precipice of electing our country’s first woman president, that advice feels more appropriate than ever. Once again, it seems we have a huge opportunity to elevate one another’s message and campaign, and deliver for those we seek to represent. body:

This sponsored message from Inside Scoop Politics is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkc9upDAMh58m3EAhf4A5cECiSCtt21Xn0GPkJoaxFBJEQrv79it2Zx6g158_-7Ps92fzDOQpLC-wYk8pmT2ZAOZG3ifjY1jKGY7f5fzljOBClfxSitbUheu1qLu5K7CvW9EqqaVqilvf8tpeNK9BS-66DxDIP1qr5UU1SjeCF9Sfc_hFtPzkdFXLuQWwDnTjOHTIFD82BxkrCokcJhvjtkVPmWyq4r4Uvr_lvCUmByYmJiYKc6z-bezAY4XuYGJCjzbHHXxpo_e4YJmO_RP_nC1ySpbJkXPdqRculPjJh_F1fHq6MtEceTUpHrtFJsdtj2lDmyks99KKjo6VyRFXIH8PLawb0BLO-OE1d695eP-TMWQMmclxen17H95G82sof1yv5eMqxd677Yu8p9S0TPHl1FQ2rkX-zn8-e_E3AAD__35UmtU)

Dear Fellow American,

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkc9upDAMh58m3EAhf4A5cECiSCtt21Xn0GPkJoaxFBJEQrv79it2Zx6g158_-7Ps92fzDOQpLC-wYk8pmT2ZAOZG3ifjY1jKGY7f5fzljOBClfxSitbUheu1qLu5K7CvW9EqqaVqilvf8tpeNK9BS-66DxDIP1qr5UU1SjeCF9Sfc_hFtPzkdFXLuQWwDnTjOHTIFD82BxkrCokcJhvjtkVPmWyq4r4Uvr_lvCUmByYmJiYKc6z-bezAY4XuYGJCjzbHHXxpo_e4YJmO_RP_nC1ySpbJkXPdqRculPjJh_F1fHq6MtEceTUpHrtFJsdtj2lDmyks99KKjo6VyRFXIH8PLawb0BLO-OE1d695eP-TMWQMmclxen17H95G82sof1yv5eMqxd677Yu8p9S0TPHl1FQ2rkX-zn8-e_E3AAD__35UmtU)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkc9upDAMh58m3EAhf4A5cECiSCtt21Xn0GPkJoaxFBJEQrv79it2Zx6g158_-7Ps92fzDOQpLC-wYk8pmT2ZAOZG3ifjY1jKGY7f5fzljOBClfxSitbUheu1qLu5K7CvW9EqqaVqilvf8tpeNK9BS-66DxDIP1qr5UU1SjeCF9Sfc_hFtPzkdFXLuQWwDnTjOHTIFD82BxkrCokcJhvjtkVPmWyq4r4Uvr_lvCUmByYmJiYKc6z-bezAY4XuYGJCjzbHHXxpo_e4YJmO_RP_nC1ySpbJkXPdqRculPjJh_F1fHq6MtEceTUpHrtFJsdtj2lDmyks99KKjo6VyRFXIH8PLawb0BLO-OE1d695eP-TMWQMmclxen17H95G82sof1yv5eMqxd677Yu8p9S0TPHl1FQ2rkX-zn8-e_E3AAD__35UmtU)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkc9upDAMh58m3EAhf4A5cECiSCtt21Xn0GPkJoaxFBJEQrv79it2Zx6g158_-7Ps92fzDOQpLC-wYk8pmT2ZAOZG3ifjY1jKGY7f5fzljOBClfxSitbUheu1qLu5K7CvW9EqqaVqilvf8tpeNK9BS-66DxDIP1qr5UU1SjeCF9Sfc_hFtPzkdFXLuQWwDnTjOHTIFD82BxkrCokcJhvjtkVPmWyq4r4Uvr_lvCUmByYmJiYKc6z-bezAY4XuYGJCjzbHHXxpo_e4YJmO_RP_nC1ySpbJkXPdqRculPjJh_F1fHq6MtEceTUpHrtFJsdtj2lDmyks99KKjo6VyRFXIH8PLawb0BLO-OE1d695eP-TMWQMmclxen17H95G82sof1yv5eMqxd677Yu8p9S0TPHl1FQ2rkX-zn8-e_E3AAD__35UmtU)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3faf0d8c34624db9a386f53ab0cc3c09&_e=_59Zs7bgo0BJInfADRwWWHY1FMgzn1SUb0HzX4tYiGFVM0zvFMGV4aggU_DhKFxCH5M5miVP__BENvm0fm11K7pJ8fANZcS3qyz-zQmEVp4UGfRyn4VQz8SxHJlq2Y%3D)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3faf0d8c34624db9a386f53ab0cc3c09&_e=_59Zs7bgo0BJInfADRwWWHY1FMgzn1SUb0HzX4tYiGFVM0zvFMGV4aggU_DhKFxCH5M5miVP_t6xU5fCYXLMKDLmndPui7HMoCW3mo1B6YW5nR9Gea4eG1NkU3G0hQIB8uV4Qtlpcz3I3AxdorLnwoRhR5q2WiwsKpDV1LyO8gIeMsu5SbxmT5WMafTWx1l3gkJiH4UfBZgPlP3sDudIqeFTU0JEsSsfuHCivaIzLuWDHCdYnLdRNx2gNexggVjYVHZ7ygQ2vx27DukaSkgxYQmw22HjcQlJV5TpgOv6-_9-9qrnCX1pN1nBPPySbSa2Q1ORBy_T20bPgn-gS7VjFBcTnQJEAu-seOzR90FYksyJG6v_ItulP8_-lFFLFe5E00RQh08HqGoaQ1AsOWRqqi4om3dyCe9a35FV7eUWP_U%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3faf0d8c34624db9a386f53ab0cc3c09&_e=_59Zs7bgo0BJInfADRwWWHY1FMgzn1SUb0HzX4tYiGFVM0zvFMGV4aggU_DhKFxCH5M5miVP_t6xU5fCYXLMKDLmndPui7HMoCW3mo1B6YW5nR9Gea4eG1NkU3G0hQIB8uV4Qtlpcz3I3AxdorLnwoRhR5q2WiwsKpDV1LyO8gIeMsu5SbxmT5WMafTWx1l3gkJiH4UfBZgPlP3sDudIqeFTU0JEsSsfuHCivaIzLuWDHCdYnLdRNx2gNexggVjYVHZ7ygQ2vx27DukaSkgxYa1lnQRnxaWsvTNKNYLP-rN_eFM1QXRYfqXmE246CmRHTSUiGhybj9mDUShwwSTE5ToNntUfvsBjZiQlB1suJuzewLM8ADBCE1yubb6si2BuoIPdm2aCa2RQ-zxLPghPX0SXUbG-q0JWE5nO2-XmCGM%3D)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include: Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;" Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty; Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people; Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers. Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future. So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below: And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. ## NYC Mayor Indicted in Bribery Probe
New York City Mayor Eric Adams was [indicted Thursday on federal charges](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGnwRsRHBicgaGLt3TtaF3gnFyLjYWpI7991c6d_-HX93GbbsiZ18c7LhTaXCaMjQ-arhK8BDvZLoWZCMh0FLQHb20_ONM9g8YeyFLsYwStXSQ7m94YMg6Nc4AdB1Bg1RW8VsrDcLH3QZurpruGOOiehFWUuJV6-Sy8tifN-SwH1UssS5fDs7VtF-ZNwChgxG2l1_6bBIyZDxIwUuUoMeGyy5Ve8iz1S0Zup1zwLFXymjg2SvJ7S9ho72pI24tz5t15YdVjQc5_s_Y__QjwEwAA__-joVxv) of accepting bribes and illegal campaign contributions from foreign sources, becoming the first sitting mayor in city history to face such charges. Prosecutors allege Adams engaged in "long-running" corruption dating back nearly a decade, including accepting free travel and luxury accommodations from [Turkish officials](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu7CAQRb8Gd1gwZsEUFK9xt69NaWEYryfBsGLJWv77yKnTXelKR0fn4z7fPSXKj_9-R9fWMvvQ6I2z5WA4qFl10a2IgEOHThowSt1GPXSbM4vUKDTKMFqwAoUGVIOBIWgLPkJHDgQoYcFIIQyMvVpGOViJi4QwyhsyJTBSK7X_LJTbhms6yxtrH8reJbe19nyx4R-DicF0HEcf8hKuk8F0oRlMwl5bM5gyHvws9YsHaiff_Vkqx0qB--j3F6ccKTSMnDJfMWL1iYfyXVu_tT111cXnQSnRSxumxGP3lH412t9R3g5-AgAA___w_GLL). Adams vowed to stay in office and fight the charges, calling himself a "target" in a case "based on lies." The indictment follows months of escalating investigations, including searches of top aides' homes, device seizures, and resignations of Adams' police commissioner and schools chancellor amid mounting scrutiny. [Here's a timeline of the probe](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DGPpCAUwPFPgx1GHihYUFxysZtrLpcrDeJT3y7CBJiZuJ9-s1tv_W_--f2_zTdHgeL-x51o65Zm5ys9cR45aA5qVs1qN0RA2aAVGrRSvRlkc1i9DG4AM_jRuFH1C3jjEdatGzfntHYNWehAdSNo0XUaTKsWI-QocBHgjeiRqQ5Xqim3b4liPXALV3pibn06m2CPWu-FyV8MJgaTW3zEV2n39JUZTP_-MpgqnRgoIi_osj-w8PJY7gmjK7wgfTwyFr6mfae484gvfqX8zj3Vi8FUasoXkxOtTP4WQg6gB9k32a73F4VAZdBMdfvpKHwv1Z-BnhY-AwAA__-wUmi6).
## Hurricane Helene Threatens Historic Damage
Hurricane Helene was expected to [deliver devastating impacts](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71yhCAYRuGrwY4d-ECRgiKN3aZN6SC8riT4M8i6k7vPJHXqU5x5Pu7j3aectse7X-HqvI8-1HRhtJwMJz3qJroZIKgGThoyWrd9p5rFtbLzNghvtSIpjBXRdqIHJgsVpjg3yZEgLSwZKYSh_qanXiorMUkKvWzBtEBMdS-3zz1tdcGcv_cL5Rb2tcluqfU4mXpjNDAa_LHhdf4mRkNOFxgNy7OUFPwGviBjA6_Fhy8Uvvrj5M8j-oqzKS4er5RzOjvDtHisPuW_Rf0ffDn6CQAA__8VBFju) across the southeastern U.S., with forecasters warning it could become a "once-in-a-generation storm." Helene was scheduled to make landfall in Florida Thursday night, threatening widespread power outages and flooding for hundreds of miles inland. Take a look at [photos from Tampa on Thursday here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1u7CAUhJ8Gd7bgGP8VFLeh29umtA5wvJBgsDBZa98-2lXKdDPSaGb0fdzWG4YY0v0_7qTqlle0NTxoXVqYWpCrbJzaiID6hpSYYJJymMe-8YrQLOg22noCMpL36MYFrKUBBye4aYICDpIvMAnOJ5g7aWbRL4KMADuLgZjk5ELNpfvMIVVPW3zmB5XO5r2Jytd6nKz_x0Az0Nd1dRX3Aw0-XwEGOtF1MtCmEH6FdG9__WuVgebLS48M9OFzzWfrv0sJFhO1niIlat91DHRTlDuuEGM4x4lJft8xxPeJ-jeSh4KfAAAA__8Ro2NU). [Meteorologists caution](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhSAUQL8GN4xcUXBg6OL2unY0CBe9DQ8M4jP9-6bt2u0MZzg5H4_lYSlS2t7tE00NebGu0guXiYPiIBfZeBMQAfsGjVCgpBz02De7GQZw6zqE4IOaYBRaqwl9cBrUJLxaGzLQgewmUKLrFOhWrlr0k8BVgNNiQCY79FRzaT8zpbpjiF_5haV1-dlEs9d6nKx_YzAzmO_7bq1z14227n8OgxkTg3m_SiFnE_4wRkzIa-a10LZh4ZSiTZ6HmLOntPGbPJ5HQev5kW8sPF_VbnhySvzMV93RnhVL4tfJYBbjNOhhbIrxx00x0jkqJrvtaSn-dtb_r70MfAcAAP__XNJx7A) that damaging wind gusts of 65-75 mph could reach well into Georgia and parts of South Carolina, while 8-16 inches of rain may trigger dangerous flooding and mudslides in the southern Appalachians.
## Helene Throws MLB Playoffs a Curve
Major League Baseball [postponed the final two](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLHupCAYxJ8GOwx-4IIFxTV0e-2VBuRj5YJigNX49hev_lczmUwyk9-f9_y2McX989tuqFvIs11aPHGeKEgKYhad1wERkHeoBwlSiFG9eLdq9JNCDNa7aXB8YSjHsIxWORSWcca7qIGBYBPIgTEJqhdODXwa0A2wqGFEIhj62HLp_-a4txVDuvOJpV_y1iW9tnZUwn8RMATMdV39t9qWvb2fAgFTWy73o0curRIwW3IEzLNKwLDp8eMTY6v0rNQVe2KlR67tyDt6uiVHj2TvHEKl67eUuNgd6YoJdyRg5MgVVwwYkwRMV7Q_rphSrC9JBPtsNqb_X9vP5E4N_wIAAP__7DNvbw) New York Mets-Atlanta Braves games until Monday due to Hurricane Helene, significantly impacting the playoff race. The National League playoffs are scheduled [to start Wednesday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1y6yAQQOGnQd16YEECFRS3UefbptTws1gkyGgQscdvn3Hq9Kf45nxc16vLJd9v_91Otqe6utDzg9YZUAOqVQ3RJiIkOZAVGrVSo5nksFnJjZfz5OcwSiFmo7SgMWlCo1OUSg3ZIkfFZ9SCc43morwRchbkBQYjRmKKU8y9tstnzfe-USqv-qB2CXUfit16P04m_zFcGC6-kAsbtUZHbf2dMFxc6zkUOhkuggs5mVHBXjwcxb1qSnDk0L8bwRsCxXU6OzxrKxFOaplO8M2FL-rg7hGeuUQIrkVoLtDQbDyeuZR8TpopfttdLr-y_venh8WfAAAA__9RJ2qO), with the Mets leading by one game and the Arizona Diamondbacks a half-game ahead of the Braves for the final wild-card spot. The playoff picture for the rest of the league [is clearer](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL-O3CAYxJ8Gd1jwGRtTUKSh27QpLf583iXBxgKylt_-5LvimqtmNPpJM5o_j-VhY4r787fdULc1L9a3-MZFUZAUxCK6oFdEwKFDzSVIIcZ5GrqXDs4zNY8KwyikUtxNEzi72hGdn9g4dFEDA8EUSM6YhLkXbuaD4ug4-JmPSATDEFsu_d8c9_bCNV35jaX3eeuSfrV2VDL8ImAImPM8-__VthzsdQMETG25XLceubRKwGzJETB3KwHD1O2nr5ieMQXqbQm0NruHuD8rvUF6JHvldaWuWP8PG7WJ7ukbImDkOCjgTDEmCZiu6HCcMaVYJ0kEe242ps_F7ef_3ho-AgAA__9RBW-d) as the Milwaukee Brewers, New York Yankees, Philadelphia Phillies, Cleveland Guardians, Los Angeles Dodgers, Baltimore Orioles, Houston Astros, and San Diego Padres have all secured spots in the postseason. The Detroit Tigers, Kansas City Royals, Minnesota Twins, and Seattle Mariners join the Diamondbacks, Mets, and Braves as teams needing help to make the playoffs. [You can see all the scenarios here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO3CAQQL_G7sYyYwy4oEiz3aVNaQEe1uQwWAzZaP8-utTXP-k9vV8f-4dLOZXnT3eR7bHuLvT0on0D1IByl-NhIxHSMpIVGrWUq1HLeFpv4uqNUusRvfeC1s0bpZ2aJUa9CTUmizPKeUMt5lmjmaQ3YtkEeYHBiJUGOdORem3T75pKPynmd31Rm0K9xmzP3m8elh8DPgZ88F1b5-ntzlq_gAEfV_ZwZ_euMTJ8uaA3Fz6pAXdXjlSeDCGnEk7gQMW1VBl6It_IfVJjcOWAu3JnclwLcDjp-JMJHEONwHR3QAUoEKU2aKazX3ls9rj_ppwTKz3I-Xm5lP8X9-__vSz-CwAA__-GQ3SB).

body:
What this means for our campaign
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=4343%2E552475%2EPkfElW)
Hi, Peter. This is Tiernan, Bob Casey's Campaign Manager.
Our campaign is rapidly approaching our final end-of-quarter deadline in just _three_ days. This is one of the last major fundraising deadlines before Election Day and a critical benchmark of our progress.
I’m going to explain further why it’s so important for us to reach our goal, but if you’re ready, use this custom supporter link to chip in today: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240927-1?refcode=em20240927-1**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240927-1?recurring=1&refcode=em20240927-1&refcode2=4343_552475_PkfElW&akid=4343%2E552475%2EPkfElW)
Running a campaign in a battleground like Pennsylvania is expensive. We need to share Bob Casey’s message with millions of voters across all 67 counties and 11 media markets in order to win this thing.
We mapped out the messages we need to get to the voters we need to reach to keep Pennsylvania blue. But right now, GOP billionaires are spending upwards of $150 million to defeat Bob, and we’re being outspent by tens of millions of dollars.
