## State Fair Gun Ban Goes to Texas Supreme Court
Attorney General Ken Paxton took his [legal fight against the Texas State Fair's](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGupCAUxvGnwQ6DZ0CloNjGbrbd0pyBg5JFMMCO7tvf3Olv_cuXfPn_ea5PDDGk7TceZNrt84q2hTetmsPEQa6yc-YlnB46MsMEk3xoJUW3G_vSgxil9wjeaidm8RgGPSqwZOfZyi4YECCFhmkQapRDLxV4BzArPaMSUjEpyIWWS992anRj9fF_flPpbT66aPbWzsoevxgsDJbruvq_N6ZvZLAkuiqD5TNjsJx4t5y43TFGShtV_hFeGzbiHkPhPhTCclT-wsRxw5A4-kaF43kSxspt_lcad2RDDTkxWLpi3HmFGEMdJybFdmCIn3Pth1ZvA18BAAD__6PBboo) firearms ban to the Texas Supreme Court, arguing that fair officials don't have the right to "nullify" state law by barring guns. Two lower courts [previously denied Paxton's appeal,](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLEOnDAQRL_GdEZmvRxQuEhDd2lTogUWsGIwsvfg8vfRndKmHY3mjd6v5_AkH_yx_qSdnbyXONAk_uKh09BowAGL2Y1m7qqCXdVAg7ar0RSb6yw2Uw0ISFNrR7J2mhFN21qqRoum8A4MoOmgqUz9wKrEGpYZoK27lmqDtULDs5eYStlY-E15CX_ixamc4l4Et4mcWdkfCnoF_X3fZYgHZ6EU_MWfkoL-4Dsr6D8oBb3pFPS06t986JPeEg89Jn-sWS9-3UR_1nUWEtYL-aTjor9gvfjElHY90qEl_gvz60y8s57iK0m5yR6K5Obz9iH4_GgUmnUnH7535T_2Lgd_AwAA__86KHNY) filed after the State Fair announced new security measures that included a complete ban on guests bringing guns to the event. Paxton's appeal argues the rule violates state law, which permits licensed gun holders to carry in places owned or leased by government bodies. Fair officials say the rule "is just a measure to create a further family-friendly atmosphere." The fair opens today and runs for 24 days. [Here's information on attending.](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO3CAURb8Gd1jwDAYKijTuNm1K6wGPGbTYWDYZb_4-ynQptry6xTk6vz7WDyy17I-fuJHvX7mtGHt50eo4GA5qVUPyQSQnB_LSgFGT00oMT59tkk6QCAIDpSlglgTOOmPnIBW5oXgQoIQDI4WelRyVhpwArHYWtVCaKUGp9HaO_UmdvvDK9U970TnGtg3VP3s_Ljb9YLAwWO77Hu-M-O9ksODZS6zEYNnpvhgstUWsDJarYyeesZz_Dd4yfzP4gedn2R-8l_hJncf2-2g7L3tu54a9tJ3BAtZwnGOUGi1PggxXdkocSQsep2iCCxCUnYfTp-MutZZrNkyJx4alvvX7NzVfHv4GAAD__ypxdow)
## Austin-Bergstrom Airport Expanding
The Austin City Council [approved a major expansion](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OqzAQRp_GdEbD-AdcuLgNXW67JTJmSKw1NjIOJG-_yvbbfdJ3mnO-btPNhRjS_b_byNbXmifnazhpMhx7jnKSzWJnWEzXkO167KUwSkLzsEKh8KtfCaA3Sinwel6coEGpGeZON8EioASDfQdKy66VCtcFcVBmcAqkYhJoCTWXtj6o0ssda3znk0rr89ZE-6h1P5j4x3BkOF7X1X6fT_qcDEdXavCRGI5bTvRmOJLPKW-fNee81XwljiDhwz6PGhJ3oey5VE6v3aUj5MR9fiYfInf7XvJJB_c51eJ8PRiOqA03enADgeDkRc_lIBw3nfTca5ppWTWsTjTFLvsVYgyH7pmE--ZC_FWofxQ9Lf4EAAD__76Nd-8) of Austin-Bergstrom International Airport that will nearly double its size by 2030. Projects include a [new 20-gate concourse](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvgzAUhH-N2YzMww548NCFLV07ooexwYpjI_MC6b-vkqFSh26n-4Y7fV_X8YohhrR84t0Zevo8oqVwuFFz6DjIUVazmcSsm8qZpoNOtlpJUa1GzC1OuhPTZG2ve636SWopJwWtbbxXVTAgQAoNXSPURTa1VOBngF7pHpWQiknh5kC51LQ6ck_cffzOhyu1zfcqmpVo21n7wWBgMJznWd-emF6QwZDcuTMYYrYYGQz42Cmk38AxlC0XYjA0XE_81fwB3OZEBS3tnDInvDnuY1hW4j7HmM-QFm7zI9kQOW5bycd7pipm3s4QY9gvHZNiuWOI77v0j73DwE8AAAD__2VOdKU), a new arrivals and departures hall, a new parking garage, and an expanded curbside drop-off area. Work has already begun on expanding one of three TSA checkpoints and building a new outbound baggage handling system. The estimated $4 billion "Journey With AUS" plan is being [funded by FAA grants](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2S2yAUQOGnQR0euAJhFRRp1DltSs3lRzYZBBq4lu23z2S33vprzpw_t_WGKady_417tPTe6oqe0hnXmYPhoFY1BOtEmOUQrTRg1DhrJYaHdVKgE-M2Be_GzZlRXKU0YRKTDkK7aUgWBCgxg5FCT0pelIYtAFz1fEUtlGZKxJCotgs9IsU39i1_6hnbxdd9yPZBdHQ2_mKwMFi86_jslMp_ZbCU-OoMllw9ZgbLt3Gf6MN9fRafMsfjaPWMne_4tzbua6GGnjrfauOY2lEb8fg-sPRUy9BsOF4p59Qnw5S475jyVwr9cOa08C8AAP__JIto1g), airport revenues, bonds, and reserves.
## 3D-Printed Hotel Going Up in Marfa
The world's [first 3D-printed hotel](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvgzAQhX-N2YzMcQY8eOjClq4dkcFHsOrEyL6E9N9XROrY8b03vE_f12W6uBDD_frpbmT5tabJLRyeNBkJvQScsPJ2Vt40Fdmmhx5bo1FVmx3mzrhZY6N9C57aZdbDQmSWfsB2VmsVLChAZaBvlO6wqVHD6gEGbQanFWqBinzglGveiOnlyhp_0pNyvaRbFe3GvBfRfggYBYzHcdSZHky5nPvZpBy9gPFR_kKRa8iFZevlnsOdycstMUXJ7puKLJvbSb6f5MkmlZHQCRirbP1-hBhD6XqB6npzIb4p-B8pTwu_AQAA__-rSGQH) is being built in Marfa by the owner of the existing El Cosmico hotel and campground there in partnership with Austin-based 3D printing company ICON. The crane-sized Vulcan printer stands 15.5 feet tall, is 46.5 feet wide, and weighs 4.75 tons, while the "ink" is a proprietary cement-based material called Lavacrete. The architects say the technology allows them to [make curved walls](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O2zAQhJ-G6tag1tRfocIIoO6SMqVBeVfWIhQpkGvrLk8f2E2qq2cGH-b7_XH98BIk3n_6jUf9XNLV31SefB0AO0B3dRWNs6WhrnisO-zceWicrdbx1rpbuwxo0c-dn62bF-wHImvboV-IKhnRorMDdrVtWlefXIMLIfbN0PvGusY4yySa8klXVv70ZQlf6cn5dEtbFcZVdS_mfDE4GZyO4zhtJb4ygxNHeBSDU5CFi34FNjhp9k8Or2rKgaDAIrkonAn2LFGZYE3KAWaWeIc98-4zE0iENxzcGXJKWwEfCeoe1rRxAU0wM8wPCQqP8lr6CBLpUTSLD1DkL9N_SDY4-QyXS53vv_78qPJI-yEhSGk74-x98xLe__Qb3c8R_wUAAP__tPWFXg) and to experiment with more organic forms and shapes. The project is part of a 60-acre expansion that will include 43 hotel rooms and 18 residences. ICON is [the same company](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOpCAURp9Gu2sQQcaCYpvpZtstDcJVbxa5BhmdffvN2P_dV5x8OTl_XuPLUaS0_HYb2vKZeXS-0InjANKAVKOqg51EGNoabWukUd2glahXO3k3TINop963Qj86YVQvWuWMk1qZztRkpZBKDNK0QveqbZSWc5DyoYeH00LpSgkMVDg3ZcWCH3fM8R-fmBvPWx3tWsp-VN2vSj4r-byuqyHPaXpTDF-iks-E15H5nhjB87GRZ3ApwJcElxK_k0dYMr9TmDK6v5QW4BkuzjEcMFM-CnQB9kypYICVC8b7IeCJkfcNUwFKsLk8O7gt62zDflGMdPSmUmLZHMXbufyQ8LTyfwAAAP__vbx3Rw) also working on a 3D-printed neighborhood in the Austin suburb of Georgetown.

| | I'm writing to ask you to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.Actually, in my case, it's a slippery _slide_. My name is Riley Gaines and I'm the University of Kentucky swimmer who had to compete against a fully intact 6'4" _male_ swimmer dressed in a women's bathing suit.And after he stole the victory I had worked for my entire life, I had to go back to the women's locker room and undress out of my wet bathing suit while he did the same next to me.

| [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3bf65d570f2e46e2b527048fdc97b031&_e=qiTZwr43SBo6EwKZAPElDnrdh9Y0LBhRbGzPuSV0FPpesUp0pmAd67TZg3aCg26DUV_pUlpKKPkg9Xk-wbz_meaIYy-5vabpskuymQSDuGz6uImKCs39DodqKGYsjRKBlC-nGKPewxhRc4D1bq5lWhZ8yoVOfXocY9gS87qDaLlLzS3VPSYtBt-gQJK-T17GJkVD7ms_1wiuTOauIu_6GkFIHYot3cTaNSAfY55Qrvo0YkZyN-sqPKrS4bRa8LeQ6-IvdXX2Yxs7GeAn7rNc0C2uWXy_9DLVj7tASaQCuReLFeu2HM3FmxVKnZnE-hwl3EYFKXiksc6wKpXSdZ06VwYdkUUP-A5nzXdGevk60IGtYETEz7MbHJFhk2EePB9ztITUBY0R-R_CpbEVnvstlA%3D%3D)

| | I know the images I'm bringing up are horrible. But please don't stop reading -- because God-fearing, faith-filled people like you and me have a job to do today. We can't retreat into our homes and hope our government's evil culture just passes us by. **[That's why I'm asking you to stand with me today -- before it's too late.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3bf65d570f2e46e2b527048fdc97b031&_e=qiTZwr43SBo6EwKZAPElDnrdh9Y0LBhRbGzPuSV0FPpesUp0pmAd67TZg3aCg26DUV_pUlpKKPkg9Xk-wbz_meaIYy-5vabpskuymQSDuGz6uImKCs39DodqKGYsjRKBlC-nGKPewxhRc4D1bq5lWhZ8yoVOfXocY9gS87qDaLlLzS3VPSYtBt-gQJK-T17GJkVD7ms_1wiuTOauIu_6GkFIHYot3cTaNSAfY55Qrvo0YkZyN-sqPKrS4bRa8LeQyY14uK2pJ3iyeK3ZEjCSzJzFwcRe9iSxQs95eIUoIo9GvmMeP_Snpv4GVBPPhKTpzwM6TrkbJ9LYfpfFsNuPEaKUEObirnjaqId1XGdzRsxa7rq9aO5V8w3QnHWZhdjxDNglXLvwz5s558LapSWKLg%3D%3D)** My fellow conservative, you know this slippery slide.It's the same one you got pushed down when the Left told you abortion was going to be "safe, legal, and rare."_Now abortion is a "right" and "women’s healthcare." And if you don’t support it up until the moment of birth, you must "hate women."_ It's the same slippery slide you got pushed down when the Left told you limiting gay couples to civil unions was "mean." You were told, "They just want to use the word "marriage" like everyone else. It's just a word."_Now if you don't fully embrace a homosexual lifestyle by displaying rainbows and celebrating gay pride, you're a "hate-filled bigot."_ Enough with their lies. We have Truth on our side. And we need to start acting like it.**God created man. And God created woman. It isn't any more complicated than that.** Letting men believe they are women... letting girls believe they are boys... is a bold-faced rejection of God’s truth. And if we give this deranged movement one more inch, a year from now when you're forced by law to call boys "she"... when it becomes normal for kids to be taken away from parents who oppose this evil... **Peter, be brave for a minute and imagine a future Trump presidency.** Think of him living up to his promise to be a “dictator on Day One.” Visualize the Project 2025 revenge tour against the “Deep State” and threats to use the legal system to round up immigrants and go after his political opponents. Picture how another Trump presidency not only endangers the lives and livelihoods of millions of Americans, but threatens the very fabric of our democracy itself. Now imagine what can slip through the cracks in all of that chaos. One thing that no one is talking about right now, but plays a huge role in the future of the American experiment is the census. **Project 2025 has a plan to install partisan officials to decide who gets counted and who doesn't.** (And you can imagine how that might go.) Here's why that could be devastating: The question of who gets counted plays a critical role in how state legislative and congressional maps get drawn, and how the federal budget is allocated. That's why it's always been nonpartisan officials in charge of the rules. **What Trump's Project 2025 is trying to do is reshape our country by dramatically altering the census — whether it be for redistricting, or simply allocating funds from the government.** The NDRC is doing everything we can to defeat these radical attacks on the census and our democracy. # HERE THEY GO AGAIN
---
| | |
---|---
Here we go again. Establishment Republicans don't want me to run for state senate in Senate District 10 and are doing their best to try to stop me. It's actually election interference.

As you may remember, Chesterfield County Republicans voted in a new Chesterfield County GOP Executive Committee in March.

The Old Guard that got kicked out is ticked off and they are trying to stir things up for me again, but this time in the 5th Congressional District where I now live.

One of the former "kicked out" members who isn't even in the first or fifth district is trying to interfere in the election.

I am the front runner in this race and they are afraid of me.
They know I will win.

Just like they tried to take out President Trump and disqualify him, they are trying to do to me. Please see the documentation below as this is unfolding.
| FROM THE DESK OF FORMER STATE SENATOR AMANDA CHASE
---
|
# RESPONSE TO
# 4TH DISTRICT CHAIR'S
# INAPPROPRIATE EMAIL
---
| September, 27 2024
Dear Chairman Buchanan, As Republicans, we should all be on the same team.
My apologies in advance for the inappropriate and felonious statement from current 4th Congressional District Chair Carey Allen, who has no jurisdiction or authority on matters pertaining to the First Congressional District, where I last resided in Chesterfield for almost 25 years and before moving to the Fifth Congressional District in Appomattox, where I now reside.
Today, I am reaching out to you to set the record straight regarding false statements made by Carey Allen, who was recently dismissed as Vice Chair of the Chesterfield GOP Committee by the voters in Chesterfield who witnessed first hand her inappropriate behavior and abuse of her position. Thankfully, in March a new executive leadership team was elected overwhelmingly 3 to 1 by Republicans in Chesterfield.
Jeff Ryer, who is the current 1st Congressional District Chair and Chris Marston, GOP attorney, have advised me on several occasions, including recently, that Ms. Allen's unsigned letter stating that I was no longer able to participate in Republican Party politics was completely illegal and void and therefore no appeal was required or needed.
Jeff Ryer and Chris Marston both stated that I am fully able to participate in Republican Party politics. In a phone conversation with Jeff Ryer on September 26, Jeff stated that he would contact both you and the Appomattox Chair to correct Carey Allen's continued false statements and that I am eligible for membership.
Sadly, this is yet another nefarious attempt by Ms. Allen to insert herself in areas in which she has no authority and for the sole purpose to cast doubt on my reputation as a Republican in good standing in a community where I now reside.
I've included documented photos from my Facebook page that Carey Allen omitted showing where I did in fact support the Republican nominee for State Senate Glen Sturtevant and the entire Republican Ticket on both September 12, 2023 and November 4, 2023. In the first post I even discouraged my supporters from issuing a write-in campaign.
There's nothing wrong with asking questions of a party official who is presiding over the election process, when some campaigns are given more access to the process than others, leaving an appearance of maladministration.
I had every right to challenge then Chesterfield County Chairwoman Leslie Haley's decision to allow my opponent Senator Glen Sturtevant's campaign manager to be the sole campaign present for the certification of the early voting machines, instead of choosing a neutral Republican to oversee the process and casting a dark cloud over the process.
Our campaign went through the proper channels legally and through the party to express our concerns. In fact, Chesterfield Republicans were so upset over these actions by Ms. Haley and her executive committee to include Ms. Allen, that they were swiftly voted out of office and replaced by now Chairwoman Dee Dee VanBuren and her executive committee.
This is simply a matter of sour grapes by 4th Congressional District Chair Carey Allen. Perhaps she is upset because the slate of Chesterfield GOP candidates that I supported in the March 2024 primary won and as a result she lost her position as Vice-Chair, a position she has held for over a decade.
I have faithfully supported our Republican nominees since I first joined the Chesterfield GOP in 2008 and have been a loyal and faithful member who has worked for many of our elected members of Congress, Governor and Attorney General and as a representative of countless campaigns.
I've also served as a member of the Senate as a Republican for 8 years from 2016 through 2023. These are simply baseless allegations that should be dealt with and seen for what they are- sour grapes. Carey Allen and her executive committee failed to follow the Republican Party Plan and illegally kicked me out of the party. Here's the clencher. I was their 2019 Republican Virginia Senate nominee for Senate District 11. Thankfully, I still won despite their attempts to sabotage my campaign.
Ms. Allen has never run any of her baseless claims before the Chesterfield County Republican membership, and any meeting she did have was behind closed doors. I've never been called or asked for an explanation for any of her allegations, in violation of the Party Plan.
No vote from the Chesterfield County Republican Committee was EVER taken on her actions against me. She knew she wouldn't have the votes.
Republicans in Chesterfield got tired of her inappropriate behavior and correctly voted her out of office. She failed to have a thorough investigation of any of her claims over the years and not once took any of her assertions before the Chesterfield County Republican Committee or investigative committee for a vote. She made these decisions either on her own or behind closed doors.
Carey Allen should be disciplined appropriately for her baseless attacks and continued harassment of a respected member of the community and former Republican senator who has worked tirelessly for her district before legal action is taken for her continued harassment, defamation and interference with an election.
She is trying to interfere with my 2024 Senate campaign for Senate District 10 and should be immediately instructed by party leaders to cease and desist before I seek legal action for her continued harassment and defamation.
Make no mistake. This is an attempt by Ms. Allen to try to delay or deny my membership to the Appomattox GOP which should take place this coming Tuesday, October 1 and cast doubt over my ability to seek the Republican nomination for State Senate. Party leadership must immediately intervene before further damages are incurred.
Sincerely,

# INAPPROPRIATE STATEMENT FROM 4TH CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT CHAIR
---
|
Dear Chairman Buchanan,
I hope this message finds you in good health. Pursuant to the direction of Chairman Rich Anderson, I am writing to formally notify both you and the Chairman of the Appomattox County Republican Committee, Ms. Robin Wolfskill, of former Senator Amanda Chase's relocation to Appomattox County, and her intention to join the Appomattox County Republican Committee. This communication serves as formal notice of her current membership status within the Virginia GOP.
As you may be aware, Senator Chase has been previously removed from the Republican Party under the provisions of Articles I and VII of the Party Plan, resulting in two separate four-year removals. The first removal took effect on September 30, 2019, and the second on March 19, 2024. Senator Chase did not file an appeal within the 30-day period afforded for such actions, with the respective appeal deadlines of October 30, 2019, and April 19, 2024. Consequently, she is currently barred from participating in any party activities until April 19, 2028, pursuant to her most recent Article I violation.
To ensure full awareness among the necessary parties, I have copied Jeff Ryer, whose jurisdiction partially covers this matter, and who was present as a member of the Credentials Committee when Senator Chase was formally notified of her second removal during the Chesterfield County Republican Committee (CCRC) Canvas on March 19, 2024. The Credentials Committee, under the leadership of former CCRC Chairman Leslie Haley and Credentials Chairman Tara Carroll, issued the notice. Former CCRC Chairman Tara Carroll had also overseen the handling of Senator Chase's first Article I violation. For complete transparency, I have also included RPV Chairman Rich Anderson and RPV General Counsel Chris Marston in this communication.
Senator Chase's most recent four-year removal was precipitated by various social media posts in which she expressed her intent to run a write-in campaign against the then-Republican nominee, now duly elected Senator Glen Sturtevant for the 12th State Senate District. Furthermore, she publicly called for the resignation of Leslie Haley and voiced her refusal to support Senator Sturtevant, citing her belief that he was dishonorable. These statements were made during the June 26, 2023, meeting of the CCRC, addressed to the entire body prior to adjournment. It is important to note that Senator Chase had previously declared in writing her intent to support the party nominee, as required for her candidacy in the Republican Primary for Senate District 12, which was held on June 21, 2023.
If you or Ms. Wolfskill have any questions or require further clarification, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Sincerely,
Carey Allen Chair, 4th Congressional District Republican Committee

Fellow Patriot,

This is Ron DeSantis, and I need to talk to you about Ohio – and a man named Bernie Moreno.

This year, the Senate is within reach – but it’s not going to happen without fighters like Bernie. He’s an America First patriot and political outsider who isn’t afraid to stand up to the establishment in Washington, D.C. Bernie’s got a backbone, and **he’s ready to fight like hell for the values we hold dear:** secure borders, less government, and an economy that works for _you_.

**Before I continue, will you take a moment to chip in whatever you can to support my friend Bernie Moreno?** ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=7525269.984.1.d76ee292d6c4d67d823fdcb192148c92 )

Ohio could be _the_ state that decides whether Republicans take back the Senate. Sherrod Brown has been there for far too long – **_50 years_** of political nonsense, bad decisions, and turning his back on everyday Americans. **Enough is enough.**

If we flip Ohio, we flip the Senate. _It’s as simple as that_. And Bernie is the man to get it done. **As it stands, he is neck and neck with Sherrod Brown in a virtual TIE!** Despite all of the hard work Bernie and his team have put in, we’re entering a phase of the campaign during which many are won and lost. **That’s why I’m asking you to step up right now and help deliver the support that could tip the scales in our favor.** ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=7525269.985.1.ea9e6829c72252a3a69737800867ea4a )

Let’s do this – together, we’ll make sure America First wins.

**Governor Ron DeSantis**

**Meet Bernie Moreno:**

( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=7525269.993.1.ebf9d4428586b2052de9d97ed1adebb8 ) Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First.

Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has.

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1997%2E135344%2EWw5F_X)

Friend —
Here’s a stat that sums up Republicans’ laser focus on Michigan: in the last five weeks, Donald Trump has visited Michigan on five separate occasions, including today. That makes eleven total visits to our state since he entered this race.
As you read this, Trump is in Michigan for a two-stop tour that takes him to Walker, Michigan, on the west side of the state, and to Warren, Michigan, in the southeast part of the state.
In the final 39 days of an election, the candidate’s time is the most valuable resource a campaign has, and you can bet that campaign teams don’t just set the schedule willy-nilly.
Each visit generates a surge of volunteer activity, excitement, and media attention, not only for Trump’s candidacy but also for Republicans down the ticket. So the choice of location, venue, and audience is all very much thought-through.
So you can bet that Trump will be here as much as he can in the final 39 days. Because his team knows what we know — Michigan is a must-win in order to secure the presidency and for Republicans to take control of the Senate.
And polls show that the race for the presidency — and our race — are a dead heat.
With voting already underway in Michigan, Trump is parachuting in at every chance he gets. It’s why Republicans are cranking up the attacks against me and other Democratic candidates, and why outside groups are blanketing the state with tens of millions of dollars in TV ads.
Trump and Republicans are doing all they can to maximize the final 39 days. They have turned the urgency dial up to eleven.
So this is the big moment for us. People are casting their votes now, as you read this. And we need to do our best to match and exceed the energy Trump generates for the Republican base in Michigan.
[**So with that: will you chip in $3 directly to my campaign before Trump wraps up his visit to Michigan later today?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240927-1-900&t=2&akid=1997%2E135344%2EWw5F_X)

In Wisconsin, an outdated law **__from 1849__** continues to threaten bodily autonomy. A court ruled that abortion care should be available despite the trigger law, **but full reproductive healthcare is now only available in 3 _counties_ – and OB/GYNs continue to leave the state, creating healthcare deserts across Wisconsin.**

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93674766/501269550/1553450153?refcode=EM_F_240927harrison_N_AS_NO_11_G_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjIxNGY0NDRkLWNlN2MtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Ti9E1ECW3-Q7zPt-45p7MVyVSBgpHUs9WJ5CrK1vX6k=)
---
Sarah’s opponent does not support a woman’s right to make her own reproductive healthcare decisions. He has voted in favor of abortion bans and even supported a bill requiring that **"Abortion Reversal Drugs"** be made available. As Sarah points out, these drugs are not scientifically proven and are not endorsed by leading organizations such as the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists.

Meanwhile, here is what Sarah has to say on abortion rights:

Don't make the mistake of waiting until it is too late. Stock up now on these survival food kits while you can.

Now is our chance -- at long last -- to defeat him at the ballot box once and for all. Let's make it happen by standing together. name: Jill Stein
subject: “Is there a letter under Z?”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
There isn’t a grade low enough for U.S. climate policy.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_summit&n=1)
---
Peter,

This week is the U.N. Climate Summit in New York, where world leaders, diplomats, and experts get together to talk about global climate policy.

But people are increasingly fed up with “solutions” that amount to pouring a cupful of water on a raging wildfire (not unlike the dozens of major wildfires currently burning across the U.S.).

It’s bad enough that even John Kerry – stalwart conservative Democrat, former Secretary of State and former Climate Envoy – had this to say to the summit attendees this week:

_“In Dubai almost 200 countries agreed to transition away from fossil fuels in a way that’s fair, equitable and orderly ... and they_** _[fossil fuel companies] are just plowing ahead, like it’s business as usual._**_”

_ _Asked to give oil and gas companies a grade in their efforts to transition to cleaner energy, Kerry said:_**_“Is there a letter underneath Z?”_**
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_summit&n=2)
---
With all respect to Secretary Kerry, spare me your outrage.

You served under two Democratic presidents (not to mention a lengthy Senate career) with ample opportunities to advance meaningful climate action. In fact, it was quite literally your job in the Biden administration to address the climate emergency.

Kerry’s wealth, political power, and unprecedented access to world leaders could have made him a powerful ally in the fight for climate justice. **But right now, the administration he served is bragging that they’ve issued more drilling permits than any other administration in history.

** However, as they say, even a broken clock is right twice a day. His point is correct. World governments have most certainly failed our people and our planet – and **there is no grade low enough**.

Last year these same world leaders gathered in DUBAI of all places – one of the crown jewels in the fossil fuel monarchies of the Middle East – to talk about their commitment to transitioning off of oil and gas.

**Fossil fuel companies ARE conducting business as usual** , drilling and burning more than ever and acting as if there are no consequences for their conduct – **exactly as they’ve done for the more than 50 years they’ve known about the realities of global warming.

** As you read this email right now, **there is a 822 mile wide hurricane with a 1100+ mile tail ramming into Florida** , having made landfall as a Category 4 storm and blanketing the state.

_If you are in the path of danger for this horrendous storm, I sincerely hope you and your loved ones are able to get to a place of safety._
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_summit&n=3)
---
There are also 34 active major wildfires burning in the U.S.

Around the world we’re seeing floods in Europe and Bangladesh impacting MILLIONS of people, and wildfires tearing through the Brazilian Amazon.

2023 was the hottest year in recorded history...until 2024 quickly overtook it.

We are facing climate collapse and an imminent threat to the survival of our species, yet both candidates from the corporate duopoly are bickering with each other about who loves fracking more.

**This is the new normal, and normal will keep getting worse if we keep doing business as usual.

** Our only path forward is a comprehensive and complete re-ordering of our society with a rapid transition off of fossil fuels and shoring up our infrastructure to withstand the superstorms, wildfires, droughts and crop failures that are still coming our way due to five decades of failing to act.

We have that plan in our platform, [**a REAL Green New Deal**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/platform?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_summit&n=4) (not the nonbinding green “suggestions” put forth by AOC) with concrete plans to transform our energy infrastructure and create millions of jobs in the process.

**[Our campaign remains the ONLY pro-worker, pro-humanity, pro-peace and PRO-PLANET, climate emergency campaign with a path to the White House this November. Can you donate now to help me build our field teams in critical states?](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_summit&n=5)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_summit&n=6 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_summit&n=6)
---
Many young people have checked out of this election because they have correctly assessed that neither major party candidate is serious about their survival.

**But we do not have the luxury of giving up.** Those of us with the capacity to keep fighting must continue.

It takes time to move public opinion, but the more of us there are out there speaking the truth and putting clear, actionable solutions into play the faster we can move this dialogue into concrete results. That’s what is so infuriating about elected leaders who refuse to be clear and forceful about the truth.

There is no country more responsible for the current state of the climate and global climate policy than the United States. We owe it to each other, and to our brothers and sisters around the world, to set this right.

We must take our fight for climate justice to the highest halls of power. It’s the only way.

[**With your support, we will.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_summit&n=7)

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_summit&n=8 "Support Jill Today!") [Support Jill Today!](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_summit&n=8)

name: Tina Forte
subject: Our New Headquarters & Materials
body:
Friends,

I wanted to let you know how much I appreciate your support of my campaign for Congress.

We have done so much this year to help build up our movement. From walking door to door with palm cards, to putting up posters at shops and restaurants (and even home windows), to placing signs on lawns throughout the Bronx and Queens.

_We have opened our campaign headquarters in close coordination with the Republican Party and Conservative Party at 943 Morris Park Avenue in the Bronx._

**You can stop by the campaign HQ during the day to pick up signs, literature, stickers, or posters. If you need materials delivered, please reply to let me know what and where and we will try our best to get them to you!**

For Freedom!

Tina

_Republican (NY-14)_

Post Office Box 610050
Bronx, New York 10461**

Peter, As Americans begin casting their ballots across the country with vote-by-mail and early vote, we’ll start to get _even more_ information about this November’s election. The amount of information — paired with the intentional chaos introduced by extreme campaigns on the right — can be disorienting. Their goal is to distract us from what matters. We can’t let them succeed. There is too much work to be done to lose focus now. Here are five things to remember:
1. As a result of the work we’ve done together, Peter, Americans across the country will vote in some of the most fair congressional and state legislative districts in a generation.
2. We have a good shot at electing leaders that will hold the line against MAGA policies and continue to fight for fair maps. This is great news for democracy.
3. **But turnout matters — and it’s where we need to focus right now.** Voters have to show up and cast their ballots. With so much attention on the presidential race, our efforts to educate voters about the priority state-level races is absolutely critical.
4. Gerrymandering still poses a big threat, with opponents of fair maps actively undermining redistricting reforms, electing election deniers, and threatening mid-decade map redraws.
5. With Trump’s MAGA allies on the ballot in key state-level races, hoping to bring Project 2025 policies into our local communities, we need you now, Peter.

As a result of the work we’ve done together, Peter, Americans across the country will vote in some of the most fair congressional and state legislative districts in a generation. 2. Check out this recent headline I read in The Hill:

It definitely sounds bad.

But what they actually want is even worse:

● All pro-life laws across the country wiped out (even those simply requiring an abortionist to communicate with a minor's parent before they can prey on their daughter);
● Abortion through all nine months of a pregnancy forced on every state in the country; and
● All paid for by taxpayers like you and me.

Peter, this is why it’s so important Students for Life Action ramps up all of our Election Year Programs so we can get ahead of this madness . . . before it’s too late.

.

The good news is, Students for Life Action has been on the ground over the past several months fighting for the preborn and stopping the Abortion Lobby’s attempt at a total takeover.

Some of our specific, critical Election Year Programs you may have heard of that we’re running at full blast right now include:

Our young canvassers put in long, hard days of work knocking on doors, informing voters, converting them into Pro-Life First voters, and sometimes are even attacked by pro-abortion radicals whom they encounter.

Our students will personally knock on hundreds of thousands of doors and even collaborate with homeschool groups and church communities to expand our reach!

- Arizona*- Montana*

* Abortion ballot referendum state

This movie is one of the most powerful tools the Pro-Life Movement has right now for turning young people against abortion, as many pro-abortion/on-the-fence students who watch it have their eyes opened to the evils of abortion.

-Ballot Referendum Kits – which we’re using to educate voters and help push back against ballot initiatives undertaken by the Abortion Lobby across the country!

- Yard Signs – which we’re handing out to pro-lifers in Referendum States so they can be placed in thousands of yards to spread the pro-life message far and wide!

These programs would not be possible without your support and could not be more important.

So, please agree to your most generous contribution of:

Even a gift of just $25 (which instantly doubles to $50) would be a huge help

!

As the ONLY National Pro-Life organization targeting young voters, keeping our programs running at FULL BLAST is going to be critical to stopping the Abortion Lobby.

I just need your help to keep it all going!

Peter, now more than ever we need to stand up for Life at the ballot box.

So, can I count on you to please take advantage of this $125,000 Matching Challenge

subject: So many state voter suppression laws
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=092724_1&amount=25]
AP: Voter outreach groups targeted by new laws in several GOP-led states are struggling to do their work [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=092724_1&amount=25]
Team: if you've been with us for a while, you know all about the voter suppression laws passed in states like Florida, Georgia, Texas, and more.
Among the new, suppressive restrictions on drop boxes, mail-in voting, line warming, and other tools that help people vote came another -- tight restrictions on 3rd party groups like ours that help register new voters and deep penalties against 3rd party voter registration groups for their work.
The bad news? It's working . Florida's law in particular has curtailed pro-voter organizations from hiring staff and helping people register to vote. It's also led to a downturn in their fundraising, making it harder for them to do their other work to defend voting rights.
Instead of coordinating volunteers to go door-to-door ahead of the election or sending them to events around these states to help register eligible voters, organizations like ours are stuck trying to figure out how to help people vote without incurring $250,000 fines. It's plainly unacceptable.

subject: The Indictment of Eric Adams
body:
I Ran Against Eric Adams. I Saw This Coming | |
---
| | |
---

| Hello, I hope your week is going well. [Newsweek](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=77d4b1a48f&e=0f227c2ae3) asked me to write another op-ed about the indictment of Mayor Eric Adams, and [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=c8e93e177a&e=0f227c2ae3) it is. I hope you enjoy it.

_**I Ran Against Eric Adams. I Saw This Coming**_

Eric Adams was indicted on federal corruption charges on Thursday, the first sitting mayor in New York's history to be brought up on federal charges. The indictment accused Adams of five counts of bribery, wire fraud, and solicitation of donations from foreign nationals.

I wish I could say I was surprised. But I saw this coming.

Back in 2021 at a mayoral debate, I said, "Eric, we all know you've been investigated for corruption everywhere you've gone, city state and federal. You've achieved the rare trifecta of corruption investigations. Is that really what we want in the next mayor? [If] you enter City Hall it's going to be exactly the same."

This is someone who had managed to run afoul of the rules at every step of the political ladder. Even the union he once belonged to, the police captains union, had chosen not to endorse him. One reason I ran was that I thought I could run a good, clean, competent administration.

After Eric won, I hoped it would work out. My son was in public school. But when asked how I thought it would go, privately, I said, "When you put someone undisciplined and unprincipled in charge of a lot of people and resources, bad things generally happen."

Eric had a habit of hiring close friends, associates and confidantes for important roles that may or may not match up with their capacities or qualifications. I thought it was quite likely that his administration would be dogged by corruption, cronyism and self-dealing.

Even with these expectations, the past several weeks have been stunning. A police commissioner, school chancellor, chief lawyer, and the head of the department of health all resigning. Numerous associates under a cloud of federal investigations and confiscated personal devices.

And now this historic indictment.

I read the indictment with a mixture of curiosity and incredulity.

Do I believe that Eric Adams accepted luxury flights and accommodations from the Turkish government and then tried to return the favor? Sure.

More troublingly, do I think Eric Adams solicited donations from foreign nationals? Yes I do.

When I was running against Eric in 2021, I was surprised by his fundraising hauls. I had a national network and wound up getting the highest number of individual donors —21,960— in the history of New York City elections. But at every turn, Eric kept pace.

Now it turns out that some of his campaign money may have been from foreign nationals. New York City's donor matching program provides a powerful incentive for fraud—donations from city residents were matched eight to one, up to $250. That means if someone donated $250, your campaign received $250 from them and another $2,000 from the City.

In this context, if someone ran a small company in NYC with 12 employees, the temptation would be to say, "Hey, we're going to say each of you donated $250, and that's going to get $24,000 for our candidate!" If you were the head of this small company, you could put up the money for your employees—say $3,000—and then the candidate would walk away with $27,000, most of which was from taxpayers.

I like this matching system; it did what it was intended to do. It gave candidates who were lesser fundraisers like Kathryn Garcia a chance to be competitive if they could activate small donors. But bad actors could abuse it. And it looks like Eric Adams did just that. Yes, foreign actors probably used taxpayer money to boost their chosen candidate in the hopes that they would get their back scratched after the fact.

Over the past several years, my campaign has been audited by the New York City Campaign Finance Board to see whether all of the donations were properly documented. The truth is that you don't always have visibility into the people who donate to your campaign; there are thousands of people who do so for different reasons. But when I was campaigning, if I found out someone was a foreign national I would immediately say, "Oh, you can't donate. But if you know any New York residents, tell them!"

The charges against Eric Adams are, on one level, depressingly simple: He liked fancy flights and hotels, and allegedly took them. He saw a shortcut to raise money from his friends with foreign passports and allegedly took that too. This wasn't a very sophisticated operation. Instead, it's the story of a local politician who was used to favor trading who didn't realize that some of these things might speed his downfall when he got a bigger job and a bigger spotlight. One of my friends joked, "He doesn't even do corruption well."

So what now? First, Eric Adams should resign. It's impossible for him now to be an effective mayor who can enlist and retain qualified leaders to move the city forward. Who would join this administration now with him at the helm?

Reports are that City Hall personnel are almost understandably preoccupied with figuring out what comes next, and who might be coming or going. I've spoken to rank-and-file employees who are deeply demoralized. Meanwhile, life goes on for a bustling city of 8.3 million seeking the best for themselves and their families.

If Eric Adams truly wants what's best for the people of New York City, he should step down.

If Adams doesn't resign, he will lose his bid for re-election next year. His approval rating was historically weak even before these charges were brought. But that's a year of rudderless agencies and festering problems, a year that the people of New York can't afford. Things don't stay the same; they get better or worse, and without leadership, they will almost certainly get worse.

Eric Adams' story is a sad one, of a police officer turned local official turned mayor and now federal defendant. His political career is ending, and it's time for his city to move on.

Frustrated with the flawed system that allows politicians like Eric Adams to game their way into office? Check out the [Forward Party](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=becd06afc8&e=0f227c2ae3)! We're partnering with principled [candidates](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=ae2cb08308&e=0f227c2ae3) in key local races across the country to drive real change.

Andrew Yang**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

name: The Democratic Party
subject: A question we get all the time
body:
---
Derek, Here at the DNC, one question we get a lot is, “When is the best time to donate?” The answer: **_Right now._** Here’s why: We will put every dollar we raise between _now_ and Election Day to work reaching the voters who will decide the outcome of this election. Friend — There are seventeen House Republicans in office right now who represent districts that President Biden won in 2020. Arizona’s 6th Congressional District is one of them. Here's what that means: we know that our district has the votes to flip this seat blue. It will be incredibly tight and every vote will matter, but _we can do it. _ **And luckily, we have Kirsten Engel running for office. clean_body: Friend -- Like many people who care about the impact elections have on their lives, I am sure your inbox is filled with last-minute requests before the final quarterly FEC fundraising deadline of this campaign. I am invading your inbox as well, apologetically, asking for your help today. Would you be able to make a contribution to my Senate campaign before our FEC fundraising deadline ends in just a few days? If you have been thinking about donating to our campaign, now would be the perfect time -- especially with Trump coming to Michigan today, as well. I’d really love it if I could earn your support today. Because in just a few days, the final 3-month public reporting period is over. We need as much momentum as possible because this is the last deadline and this public fundraising report will be looked through with a fine-tooth comb to see how we stack up. The polls are showing that this Senate race in Michigan is a dead heat with a lot of voters still undecided. That’s who we need to get to. If we fall short of our goal before our FEC deadline ends, it puts us at risk of not being able to reach those voters -- especially in places outside of my current congressional district. I still need to introduce myself to a lot of undecided people in Michigan, and that introduction could be the difference between winning or losing in November. The hypocrisy and double standards in U.S. foreign policy are glaringly evident when comparing the American response to Russian President Vladimir Putin with its treatment of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Both leaders have been accused of grave human rights violations and war crimes, yet the United States' reactions to each are diametrically opposed. This double standard makes Americans less safe, the world less secure, and the U.S. less able to counter fascism and extremism anywhere. **Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bbb65468-6501-44bc-8aea-8622e5981248?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Russian President Putin (L) & Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu (R). Credit: Getty
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=145282886&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ1MjgyODg2LCJpYXQiOjE3Mjc0NTIwODksImV4cCI6MTczMDA0NDA4OSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.19zKNWx0xnmsLTuEr8UO9N3Gh7RVXJ-ZgffOXkxWDRc)
When the International Criminal Court (ICC) issued an arrest warrant for Putin over the invasion of Ukraine and the illegal annexation of Ukrainian territory, [the United States hailed the decision](https://substack.com/redirect/31b086f8-092c-4d64-804c-eedd084973ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). US Secretary of State Antony Blinken [encouraged all ICC member nations to arrest Putin if he set foot on their soil](https://substack.com/redirect/292819ca-c3b3-4daf-8740-dfdbe90fba20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), even leading to reports that [Putin skipped a trip to South Africa to avoid ICC arrest](https://substack.com/redirect/883f2ed6-72ed-424e-8070-2a64f5023f1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This move was lauded as part of upholding the international rules-based order, reinforcing the idea that no one, not even world leaders, are above the law.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6c1f4391-ca4e-4a81-b1b2-62360ebef70f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Yet when the same ICC considers arrest warrants for Netanyahu on charges of crimes against humanity, the U.S. takes a completely opposite stance. The United States has labeled such actions "[outrageous](https://substack.com/redirect/2d0d6e68-511a-4f2b-9ab3-743b18f8a97e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" and not only refused to support the ICC's pursuit of justice but went so far as to invite Netanyahu to address a joint session of Congress. This stark contrast exposes the selective application of justice: the U.S. applauds the ICC when it suits its geopolitical interests but dismisses it when the accused leader is an ally, no matter the gravity of the allegations.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/679bbe91-8906-4df0-a079-79ea1fa024d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..K1iAM09ZJhgduvRf1NM8G9cBcZTJYCIv7tTQlst07RI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145282886)
The double standard doesn't stop here. When Israel accused the United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA) of collaborating with Hamas, the U.S. government swiftly cut UNRWA's funding, without any substantive evidence to support Israel's claim. The suspension of aid will last until at least May 2025. However, when credible reports emerged that Israeli forces had collaborated with extremist settlers to block aid meant for starving civilians in Gaza--a clear war crime--the U.S. took no action. Despite Israel's involvement in denying humanitarian aid, which violates international law, the U.S. continues to fund the Israeli military's bombing campaigns, exacerbating the suffering of Palestinians. In fact, as reported by ProPublica, it seems undeniable that [Blinken knowingly lied to Congress about Israel blocking aid to starving Palestinians](https://substack.com/redirect/64fc32ed-3080-4cbf-ba7f-8f5dedd4fc85?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), in an attempt to continue to sell weapons to Netanyahu to further bomb Palestinians.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e2927578-de4f-4159-9403-f79b10e3f7e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The disparity between U.S. responses to Russia and Israel is perhaps most glaring in how it handles civilian deaths in war. Following Russia's invasion of Ukraine, which included indiscriminate bombing of civilian areas, [the U.S. swiftly imposed financial sanctions](https://substack.com/redirect/a2ace289-164c-4e61-a645-be72739a10b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), froze Russian assets, and called for international accountability. Russia's illegal annexation of Ukrainian land was met with divestment and international condemnation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9f0b083a-eae9-41cf-b581-5f549d15d236?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Conversely, [despite Israel's repeated bombing of Palestinian civilians in designated safe zones](https://substack.com/redirect/bd68384f-6074-44b7-88b0-a6f878189397?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--zones they were forced into by Israeli forces--the U.S. has taken no such measures against Israel. The United States not only continues to supply Israel with weapons but ignores its own Leahy Laws, which prohibit military aid to nations credibly accused of human rights violations. Even as the International Court of Justice (ICJ) ordered Israel to stop bombing Rafah, the U.S. did nothing but arm Netanyahu's regime further.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..K1iAM09ZJhgduvRf1NM8G9cBcZTJYCIv7tTQlst07RI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145282886)
Moreover, instead of holding Israel accountable, [more than 30 U.S. states have enacted anti-BDS laws](https://substack.com/redirect/44096f5a-ecde-4bee-9523-c3ef7fd0d58d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions). These are laws that criminalize economic boycotts against Israel, effectively protecting the Netanyahu government from international censure. This is in stark contrast to the American response to Russia, where economic boycotts and sanctions were essential tools in the effort to hold Putin accountable.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dec42557-8134-44ce-80d6-a8798417581d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This list of examples is far from exhaustive, but it underscores a critical point: the United States' selective enforcement of international law and human rights standards reveals a troubling double standard. When it comes to Russia, the U.S. positions itself as a defender of global norms, pushing for sanctions, divestment, and justice. But when the accused is Israel, an American ally, those same norms are conveniently ignored or outright dismissed. This inconsistency not only undermines the credibility of U.S. foreign policy but also weakens the very international order the U.S. claims to champion. And while every single life is equally sacred and precious, the disparity in U.S. treatment of Russia vs Israel becomes even more stark when considering death tolls. Putin's bombardment of Ukraine [has killed more than 10,200 civilians including 575 children](https://substack.com/redirect/03735da2-15dc-4d66-86df-704e8cc4d2d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Netanyahu's bombardment of Gaza has killed, more than 40,000 civilians including more than 16,000 children--and according to The Lancet--[the total devastation is conservatively 186,000 Palestinian civilians killed](https://substack.com/redirect/2c5d4ff7-b035-46bc-b11b-c2d1f749d088?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
If the United States is truly committed to upholding a rules-based international order, it cannot apply justice selectively. War crimes and crimes against humanity must be condemned and punished regardless of the perpetrator's identity or political alignment. To do otherwise is to abandon the principles of justice, human rights, and accountability that the U.S. claims to uphold on the world stage.

name: Evangelicals for Harris
subject: EFH Ad Campaign for Evangelical and Christian Voters
body:
New Ad Campaign Mobilizes Voters Across Key States | |
---
| | | This week Evangelicals for Harris (EFH) announced **a 7-figure, three-week advertising campaign aimed at evangelical and other Christian voters in key battleground states, including North Carolina, Georgia, Pennsylvania, Arizona, Nevada, Michigan, Wisconsin, and Nebraska.

The campaign seeks to contrast Donald Trump’s behavior and words with the values of faith, compassion, and justice that Vice President Harris embodies and encourage faith-based communities to support her leadership.**

The campaign features a series of ads that draw on biblical teachings and themes, contrasting them with the conduct of political figures who have sought to manipulate religious rhetoric for their own gain.

The newest ad, “**[Keep Clear](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=cc757bbbdd&e=43463f1dee)** ,” features archival audio and video footage of the **late Rev. Billy Graham, delivering a message based on (2 Timothy 3:1-5), warning of the dangers of leaders who exhibit greed, arrogance, violence, deceit, and the trappings of religion.** **These biblical warnings are matched with video footage of Donald Trump celebrating and exemplifying these traits.** The ad is a reminder of the contrast between genuine Christian values and behaviors that contradict them.

**Vice President Harris stands for the values that Jesus taught: love, justice, and compassion for all people. Our mission is to remind evangelical voters that Christians are called to support leaders who embody these values and are committed to serving the most vulnerable among us. **We believe that by uniting around these principles, we can bring about a more just and compassionate nation.

**Please [watch and share this ad](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=962530ab88&e=43463f1dee). _If you are in any of these key battleground states (North Carolina, Georgia, Pennsylvania, Arizona, Nevada, Michigan, Wisconsin, and Nebraska) and would like to get more involved in our campaign, or know someone who might be, please let us know._**

Thanks for all you’re doing. As always, we’re praying for you.

Blessings,
Rev. Jim Ball
Founder and Chair, Evangelicals for Harris

name: Kirsten Gillibrand
subject: do you have a minute?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
take a moment to celebrate our recent wins
| | |
---
Friend, I wanted to reach out to personally thank you.
I have so much to thank you for, so this message is a bit longer than usual. But in case you're short on time, I have to make sure that you see this first: **My final end-of-quarter deadline before Election Day is only hours away, and we're still pacing dangerously short of my $300,000 goal.****[I hate that I have to ask, but this is incredibly important: If you have anything extra to spare, can you chip in $10 to help me hit this goal? We’ve made so much progress together already, but I need your help to make sure that we can continue this work for years to come.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93707680/501361498/-1789327584?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=10&refcode=jtk5445-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOWZiYWMyMS1lODdjLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XiLi_LtliMDgmTcbD-tJhscjU4oBr6nzAOjAfWoBgjQ=)**
| | [DONATE NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93707681/501361501/-1789327584?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5445-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOWZiYWMyMS1lODdjLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XiLi_LtliMDgmTcbD-tJhscjU4oBr6nzAOjAfWoBgjQ=)
---
If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to celebrate our recent wins.
Last year, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. **And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before** — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible.
I also**released my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability.** From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen.
I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after **I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.****** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our Constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom.
Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my cybersecurity academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve.

There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. And now, Democrats are in the most difficult election year in recent memory.
Here in New York, Republicans just had their best election cycle in years. Now, they're directly targeting my seat. With a narrow 51-49 majority, we cannot afford to show any signs of weakness. **Missing my end-of-quarter goal would be sending a crystal-clear message to the GOP that this seat is up for grabs.** **[_So please, will you donate $10 or whatever you can spare before 11:59 p.m. tonight to help me continue our fight for progress this year? Because I refuse to accept corporate PAC money, I'm counting on your help to make up the gap._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93707682/501361504/-1789327584?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=10&refcode=jtk5445-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOWZiYWMyMS1lODdjLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XiLi_LtliMDgmTcbD-tJhscjU4oBr6nzAOjAfWoBgjQ=)**

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
We’ve got Jim Jordan on the ropes, and his desperation is showing.
He’s so panicked about losing that he’s asking random strangers for dirt on me.

**Knock, knock, knock.**** **_It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country._ _It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away._ _It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story.__ _ We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth. **America saved my life, and I dedicated my life to paying her back.**** ** I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, Pakistan, and 40 other countries around the world. I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn. Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending his lawyers after President Trump and two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Raiding gun shops and seizing records from law-abiding gun owners. _And he’s doing it all while real criminals are free to roam our streets.__ _ We are losing our country. You know it. But you also know we can save it. I’ve been all over the world. Believe me when I tell you, if America fails, there is nowhere else to go. **It’s time to save America while we still have a chance. I’m Hung Cao, retired Navy Captain, and now OFFICIALLY the Republican nominee for the United States Senate in Virginia. **** **[**If you’re all-in to defend the greatest country on Earth, join our team today.**](http://email.hawleyformo.com/u/click?_t=11a592fdc01846d4a1c728421295853d&_m=550c871ce0004c43b97f7f38cb82dc98&_e=qj0dUPQAtZRjd48W6EaXyYIkbktDO4NLnAuPvx5XnoNwomdQmBf8jede4rSHZKvWgpO8wowM5Nc0SlKtvku_x3MnzGSRTtTD5NDyLwrSQ-8CM-AgLAg8SrmmZuUsT1ybqO4O7R94tKlCxTSo04UHqoszYxIDwbD8S4QpL8u-XfbP_0wVukcV-5JhYOXYxbV0hUIMX_qlD048gGN4is91wn8jnYfcmWtNYEblI11atpRFuoUX1TZpEsN2qKCApruLQJhSYNGCvxMVUy04XRnIbEFajENqy49-9nlN-V0Vc74Gi1al50d1DTZWPsfeFPxwnUjPx2UWKPjUusOWm5NAp1Z0os1TCZCvR8UhaMg3ZBQ%3D)

Hi Peter,
I’ve seen my opponent, Juan Ciscomani, push aside the best interests of folks in our district for political favor or partisan gain over and over again.
But here’s the thing: he was doing this long before he ran for Congress.
As an advisor to former Governor Doug Ducey, Ciscomani worked on the deal that sold our water to farms in Saudi Arabia — and he vetted the Arizona Supreme Court judges that reinstated the 1864 abortion ban this April.
He was part of the administration that misused millions of dollars of COVID relief funds, wasted millions of dollars on the bogus Cyber Ninjas election audit, and slashed millions of dollars from our public schools.
And now he’s in Congress voting against our reproductive rights, public schools, border security, and local economy.
Peter, in Congress, I’ll fight for abortion access, water security, clean energy jobs, public schools, Social Security and Medicare, and affordable housing. Because that’s what Arizona’s families deserve, and that’s what I’ve been doing since I first ran for office.
This is a frontline seat that will decide control of the House, and every bit of grassroots support helps.
We’re up against corporate PACs that are pouring millions of dollars into supporting my opponent. We have THREE DAYS to hit our most important fundraising goal of the cycle, so I have to ask: can you make sure we don’t get outspent by chipping in now? body:
| | | Peter, it’s Captain Hung Cao, Navy combat veteran and US Senate Candidate. You might not know everything about my story, but by the end of this message, I hope you’ll take a leap of faith and join my U.S. Senate campaign today.

I dedicated my life to serving our country. Ever since I was a little kid who had just come to America after escaping communism, I knew that this place was special.

I deployed to some of the most dangerous war zones in the world during my Naval career. It was incredibly difficult - but it taught me that **America truly is the greatest nation on Earth. **

_But right now, our greatest enemies aren’t foreign adversaries - they’re socialists and America-haters within our own country and our own government. _

Washington DC insiders like Tim Kaine have put America last for too long.

I won’t let it happen for one second longer.

I’m not a career politician. I’m a combat veteran who stepped up because I LOVE this country too much to let it fall into the hands of selfish politicians who couldn’t care less about us.

The Left is pouring millions into Tim Kaine’s bank accounts to try and silence me, and as much as I don’t like asking for help, I can’t face them alone and win.

**[If you’re ready to TAKE BACK our country, I want you on my team. name: Dan Crenshaw
subject: Don’t waste your money
body:
If you want to make a political contribution, do it wisely.
| | | | | | [ ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01J8T4ZSBC87CAFC3CC02KD8F7_0)
---
|
---
| | | | Peter, It’s the end of the month, so I am sure you are getting bombarded with fundraising requests from politicians. Texts, emails, phone calls, mail, everything.
I know it’s exhausting. I know it’s annoying. I know it can be overwhelming, especially when you are told that the country will fall into oblivion unless you “SEND $5 RIGHT NOW TO SAVE AMERICA!!”
Then there are the gimmicks like “100,000 PERCENT MATCH ON YOUR DONATION IF YOU DONATE IN THE NEXT FIVE SECONDS” or “READ THIS SECRET CAMPAIGN MEMO THAT YOU ONLY HAVE ACCESS TO BY DONATING $25 RIGHT NOW.”
Don’t waste your money on that. If you want to make a political contribution, do it wisely.
Let me just be upfront - I’m writing to you right now asking for a donation. You can donate here:
---
| | [ DONATE NOW ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01J8T4ZSBC87CAFC3CC02KD8F7_1)
---
| If you aren’t able to donate, the republic will survive and I am not going to shame you for not being a loyal supporter. I know times are a bit tough right now and money is tight, so if you are not able to contribute please know I understand. But if you are able to donate, it can actually help make sure that we have the kind of government that will serve you better after November. Let me explain. Here’s what I use your donations for:
* Helping Republican incumbents win re-election (especially in California and New York.. yes, they exist). These seats are critical to holding our House majority, and they’re held by commonsense conservatives who are the kind of serious policymakers we need in Washington.

* Helping Republican challengers flip Democrat-held seats in swing states (think Michigan, North Carolina, and Pennsylvania). We have done a great job of recruiting quality candidates this year, and a lot of them are veterans, leaders in their community, or business executives and former state legislators who will also be serious policymakers in Congress. These seats are critical to growing our House majority, which we need to do so we can actually govern next year rather than being mired in the kind of political brinkmanship that comes with the 3-seat majority we have right now.

* Winning the messaging war against the left and growing our conservative movement. A big piece of winning elections is actually winning the hearts and minds of people not paying attention to politics every single day. That means creating compelling content on social media and hosting large events like my annual Youth Summit to attract young people into the conservative movement. It costs money to do this right, and your donations make sure these efforts are persuasive, compelling, and attention-grabbing.

That’s what I use your money for. I usually use it immediately - a dollar in, a dollar out. I never store it in a campaign warchest for future political ambitions. This money is actually helpful for holding the House majority and growing our conservative movement, which we cannot lose sight of in this election. While all the money and attention is being focused on the presidency for obvious reasons, we cannot forget about control of Congress as conservatives. If President Trump is elected like he should be, but is stuck with a Democrat House, then nothing gets done. Worse, actually, it will be just like the second half of his first term when every day there is a new impeachment, a new investigation, a new ridiculous House committee set up to target President Trump. If the worst case scenario happens in November, we need a Republican House majority to roadblock anything Kamala Harris might try to do and hold her accountable when she inevitably overreaches her authority. We *must* hold on to our majority in the House of Representatives. Your donations can honestly help make that happen. It’s that simple. If you want to donate and have the financial means and flexibility to do so, I would greatly appreciate it. You can do so here:
---
| | [ DONATE. JOIN THE FIGHT. ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01J8T4ZSBC87CAFC3CC02KD8F7_2)
---
| Thank you for reading my messages and for your continued support. I hope you find them informative and substantive, and find them a refreshing break from the usual political BS that you find in your inbox. God Bless,
---
| | |
---
| Dan Crenshaw
---
|
---
| |
---
| No longer want to receive these emails? [Unsubscribe](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01J8T4ZSBC87CAFC3CC02KD8F7_3).

| | **It has been a busy summer in Northwest Washington, and our work has caught the attention of some local news outlets!**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93713383/501380064/1596212816?refcode=2024-09-27-press&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=46fe846a-ee7c-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmZlODQ2YS1lZTdjLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UZCq-DggwJsCIn49n5B36EWAe_CsJAe9Pyn209qjvDs=) **This summer, I reintroduced legislation to reauthorize the Northwest Straits Commission.** In July, I visited an array of recent environment projects led by the Northwest Straits Initiative and other local groups. A healthy environment is vital to Washingtonians' way of life and the regional economy — and that is why mitigating climate change through projects like the Northwest Straits Initiative must be a top priority. Locally driven work like this is key, and I will continue to bring federal money to Northwest Washington for initiatives like this one. **[READ GOSKAGIT](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93713385/501380065/-86784979?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmZlODQ2YS1lZTdjLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UZCq-DggwJsCIn49n5B36EWAe_CsJAe9Pyn209qjvDs=&emci=0093021a-227c-ef11-8473-6045bda8aa34&emdi=46fe846a-ee7c-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=9494239)** **A new light rail station has arrived in Snohomish County!** We cannot have a big-league economy with little-league infrastructure. Many of my neighbors keep hearing devastating news of their loved ones being slaughtered by the Israeli government. Students in our district have broken down crying in school after finding out their relatives were killed. **In just one day this past week, Israel’s government killed over 558 people in Lebanon, including 50 children.** As in Palestine, Israel’s indiscriminate bombing campaign in Lebanon has targeted civilian infrastructure. About 500,000 people have been forcibly displaced already, and thousands have been wounded. The Biden-Harris administration can stop the bloodshed, rather than continuing to allow the Israeli government to operate with impunity as they carry out war crimes. This week, ProPublica released an investigation showing that **U.S. Secretary of State Blinken knew that Israel’s government deliberately blocked humanitarian aid to Gaza, but lied about it to Congress.**
Experts from multiple state agencies shared abundant evidence with Blinken. They called for a pause on arms transfers to Israel in order to comply with U.S. law—which mandates cutting off weapons to governments that block U.S. humanitarian assistance.
The U.S. government should have stopped arming Israel’s genocide of Palestinians then. In the months since Blinken’s statement to Congress in May, Israel’s government has continued to devastate and ethnically cleanse Gaza, and recently launched the largest invasion of the West Bank in decades—with fighter jets, drones, armored vehicles, and ground forces.
Now, Israel’s government is expanding its violence in Lebanon, threatening a ground invasion. **Instead of deploying more U.S. troops to the region, our government must stop military assistance to Israel.**

---
| Dear Peter,
---
| | | | | | | | | | | I am writing you today as the Top Two Candidate in CD15 because it’s time for change. In the latest bipartisan vote that successfully passed in Congress, known as H.R. 7909, my opponent made the troubling decision to vote **NOT** to deport illegal aliens who have committed acts of violence against women, even in cases where they were convicted!
How can we feel safe and secure in our own homes when our elected Incumbent fails to take the necessary steps to protect us? This is deeply concerning and raises serious questions about his commitment to our safety. My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.
