name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: Spread the word! It’s voting season!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
Friends,
We’re less than six weeks until Election Day! Absentee ballots started going out yesterday, September 26th - and we are less than a month away from early voting statewide, starting October 26th.
I’m doing what you elected me to do - expanding access to voting in Michigan for all eligible citizens. That should be the goal of every leader in this country, and it’s what my team and I work hard to do each and every day.
We are spreading the word! I had the chance to sit down with Alex Wagner on MSNBC when she was in Michigan earlier this week. Take a minute to watch and let me know what you think:
https://x.com/JocelynBenson/status/1839090005152879097 [https://x.com/JocelynBenson/status/1839090005152879097]
I’m grateful for the support you’ve shown me year in and year out as we build and grow Team Democracy. And the best thing you can do to help right now is to make sure everyone in your network knows that to cast a ballot, you have to be registered. In Michigan you can register, in person, at any time up to 8pm on Election Day at your city or township clerk’s office. But if you are registering another way (like by mail or online), your application must be postmarked at least 15 days before Election Day.
Of course - you can always visit Michigan.gov/vote [http://michigan.gov/vote] for all the information you need to vote and register to vote.
Let’s go! Happy voting!
-Jocelyn

body:
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240927&t=1&akid=1223%2E587540%2ELxkVQQ)
Peter,
**A few months ago, we announced our second round of endorsements, bringing the number of young leaders we’re working to elect this November up to _13!_**
>From gun violence to climate change to the skyrocketing cost of living, our leaders haven’t been making enough progress on young voters’ priorities. So all over the country, we’re working to transform state legislatures (and Congress!) to include young people at a rate that’s closer to our portion of the population.
**[We'll get into more detail about each of the candidates we're endorsing below, but if you'd rather skip the long email and pitch in to help us get them elected in November, you can click here to donate $5 right now!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240927?refcode=em20240927&amount=5&refcode2=1223_587540_LxkVQQ&akid=1223%2E587540%2ELxkVQQ)**
Our endorsements span 10 different states in every part of the country.
In **Arizona** , first-generation American and Rhodes Scholar Oscar De Los Santos has already proven himself as a leader in the fight to repeal the state’s abortion ban. He needs and deserves our help to win re-election this year.
In **Tennessee** , abortion rights champion Allie Phillips and immigrant rights advocate and first-generation American Luis Mata are going to make fantastic additions to the state legislature.
In **Texas** , ER nurse Molly Cook will continue to be a powerful force advocating for abortion rights and public transit in the State Senate. She won a special election to serve out the remainder of the current term, but she’ll need to be re-elected to a full term in November!
Averie Bishop is running for Texas House District 112 because she wants to create a Texas where every family and child can believe that everything in Texas truly is bigger and better. Also, Kristian Carranza has registered over 10,000 voters in Texas and is now ready to bring the fight to the Texas State House. All of the LWD-endorsed candidates in Texas will fight back against regressive bills headed to the Texas House next year.
In **Florida** , climate advocate Nate Douglas will make sure young folks’ priorities are front and center, along with Bryce Berry and Ashwin Ramaswami in neighboring **Georgia.** And in **North Carolina** , non-profit leader and former National Guard Captain Dante Pittman will do the same.
In **Ohio** , we’ve endorsed Christine Cockley for the State House. She’s determined to make housing and childcare more affordable and keep our communities safe from gun violence — along with Anna Thomas, who we’ve endorsed in nearby **Pennsylvania.**
And last but certainly not least, in **Delaware** , Sarah McBride has the chance to make history as the first openly trans member of the US Congress. She’s a badass state senator who’s been the driving force behind so many awesome bills, and we’re going to make sure she gets to take the fight to Washington next.
**If we elect even half of these candidates this November, we’ll have made monumental gains for young people's representation in government and a big boost to get young voters turning out by giving them people their age to vote for. But we’re not aiming to elect half of them — we’re aiming to help each and every one of them win on Election Day.**
**[So Peter, don't sit on the sidelines. If you're ready for a government that responds to the needs and priorities of young people, pitch in $5 today and help us elect all 13 of these fantastic candidates in November.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240927?refcode=em20240927&amount=5&refcode2=1223_587540_LxkVQQ&akid=1223%2E587540%2ELxkVQQ)**

body:
Friend, Our media team put this chart together, and it's shocking how much we're being outspent: All of the blue columns represent spending by Democrats in my race, while the red columns show spending by my campaign and our allies to help us win. Numbers like this might convince some to give up. But I never will. I know who I'm fighting for and what I'm fighting for. We lost this race by less than 1% last time, despite being outspent by a greater ratio. My question for you is: would you give up? If you still stand with me, I urge you to make an emergency donation today at [**JoeKentforCongress.com**](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/SyG763eyTUgRgXTrOxnscDVQ/LfpOQcZiQL892rKOiw3QgXlQ). Just yesterday, there were two debates in the district, and my opponent refused to show up. See this photo of me standing next to her empty podium. Her campaign lied and said she couldn't attend because of Congress, but Congress wasn't in session, and she had no committee meetings. The real reason is that she heard voters would be allowed to ask questions that aren't screened by her staff or media allies--and nothing terrifies her more. She doesn't want to have to answer for her record of voting for higher inflation, open borders, exporting jobs overseas, and voting against protecting women. She believes if she hides from voters just long enough, she can use her financial advantage to buy enough TV ads to win. We can't let that strategy succeed. Help me stop her by donating today at [**JoeKentforCongress.com**](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/Xrm7cwyhGaIz6yPGToX763Mg/LfpOQcZiQL892rKOiw3QgXlQ). I will never give up. Will you? Thank you,

If you’re like most conservatives, you get endless emails and text messages from candidates asking for money. _But how do you know if they are actually conservative and not just pretending?_ _How do you know if they even have a chance of winning?_ _How do you know if costly fundraising commissions and processing fees will consume most of your contribution?_ These are all important questions that everyone must ask if they want to be effective with their political contributions. **The Senate Conservatives Fund is one of the best ways to make your contributions count.** We do it by providing grassroots conservatives like you with a trusted list of candidates who are strong, viable conservatives. Every SCF-endorsed candidate must undergo a vetting process to help us determine whether they share our principles and values and, more importantly, will actually fight for them after the election. Every candidate must also run a professional campaign capable of winning. But creating a list of conservative candidates is just the beginning; we also give you an _**[_**effective way to fund their campaigns!**_](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a7980a1596ef4669816c008083ab192b&_e=6brVt6u8G1Fr2BeBVSYfoQDd-YkU6sTyKFF61PnZfrj4zq99zVFcdul8qm7HA4I89o9tSbX6L-B8wShrDk5oNsc6MtPOydKYqWCgke7fBHS78bJ3RAoheyGLAKle1lQm7gnad1xQ6bHNZv5GYDIEGjOMu_IBNHWSVFkkr4KTyKqaLABv0Hai-W2T-IcbXMhgarlNPOelKuYUmpAKEbwwwB1EyupQ07G2cupGwBJn5Oc%3D)**_ The best way to support a candidate financially is to donate to their campaigns. Once you move away from the candidate’s campaign — whether it be a party committee, joint-fundraising committee, PAC, or other organization — your contribution's effectiveness declines. However, donating to multiple candidates can be complicated and time-consuming, and there could be hidden fees and expenses that make this less beneficial to the candidates. **That's why SCF allows you to donate to multiple candidates with one payment and why SCF pays all fundraising expenses related to those contributions.** _This saves candidates a ton of money._ As you know, processing fees are charged for all online transactions. What you probably don’t know is that candidates also often pay steep fundraising commissions to third-party vendors, which are at least 80% of the value of your contribution. Candidates have to pay outside vendors to help them find new donors across the country, and this service is quite expensive. **That means that when you get an email or text message from a candidate and click on the link to donate $100 to that candidate, the candidate will often get less than $20 after expenses.** This is why you should [**donate to candidates through SCF**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a7980a1596ef4669816c008083ab192b&_e=6brVt6u8G1Fr2BeBVSYfoQDd-YkU6sTyKFF61PnZfrj4zq99zVFcdul8qm7HA4I89o9tSbX6L-B8wShrDk5oNota9nWFQSnGIG_cpSMSULWBrXiRWMgYhUKz_ttJNa3l9lgeYGqvJ5Yl8Gr8CcWvHdbL-sxpMds951f5gyZej4vZH9L9Ip_hkMQB02RAUPRn6xuP9vY4cr_h80HoNQIUN5WlUUqCYj5Qj43xF86gYpY%3D) whenever possible. It’s one of the only ways to guarantee that the candidate will get 100% of your contribution with no hidden fees or expenses. And if you like our work and want to help us do more to promote good candidates, you can also contribute to SCF, which is our general fund. This will help us mobilize other patriots like you to help elect strong conservative leaders.

**2024 Senate Candidates**

Here’s the list of Senate candidates we are supporting this year — three incumbents and five challengers. ▶︎ Sen. Ted Cruz (TX) ▶︎ Sen. Rick Scott (FL)
▶︎ Sen. Josh Hawley (MO)
▶︎ Bernie Moreno (OH)
▶︎ Kari Lake (AZ)
▶︎ Sam Brown (NV)
▶︎ Tim Sheehy (MT)

[**Contribute to these candidates through SCF so they have the funds to fight for our principles and win!**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a7980a1596ef4669816c008083ab192b&_e=6brVt6u8G1Fr2BeBVSYfoQDd-YkU6sTyKFF61PnZfrj4zq99zVFcdul8qm7HA4I89o9tSbX6L-B8wShrDk5oNv5ofsCkl4vUFkVnYSvqD5ww7OljWdPIF3TsDmF8YWJspr6TOXHm7EWVr_jkix9XjY5ad9IZtcGeCAth-rIF0H4g9RJUREmJtZyZPPUoEqKnmTnuWBo-Kk4nu9OBZYKwE10f03j5S9StwrQcWGSXRUc%3D) The clock is ticking, so please take action today. Derek, we need to
keep the Senate 🔵. Hard stop.

introduced a bill to protect our children from the harms of social media
in partnership with a Republican colleague.

But, I know in my bones that there is no place in the Senate for a PA
PRETENDER! like David McCormick or any of the other GOP candidates
challenging the Frontline Five for their seats.

They really want to flip the Senate, and I REALLY want to stop them. 🛑

That's why I've set a goal to raise $150,000 by midnight on September 30th
for the Frontline Five in time for the EOQ deadline. I need your support
to get there,
Derek.

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93721316/501403280/1790176412?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzgyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OWIxYmY0ZC1mYTdjLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ARsicRVlYEPysvwSHKkv1lsKUWhzT18oZlopbR9Yr5Y=&emci=252b6551-637b-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=99b1bf4d-fa7c-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=23311593) | Peter –

With just**39 days** left before the election, we need to address why this race is more critical than ever. Here are a few pressing reasons why your support is needed before our final end-of-quarter deadline:
* **Matt’s Opponent Has a Massive Advantage:** He kicked off his campaign with a $400,000 loan, trying to buy this race. And now he’s up to $1.2 MILLION of his own money invested in this race. Clearly, he believes that money can replace genuine support from the people of PA-08.

* **Top GOP Leaders Are All In:** Every major GOP figure has descended on our district to boost Matt’s opponent and rally their base. Apparently, they think a politician from Louisiana can understand and represent the interests of northeastern Pennsylvania better than Matt can.

* **Super PAC Spending Is Skyrocketing:** A Mike Johnson-aligned super PAC is pouring even more money into this race than they did last cycle at this same point in the race, ramping up their efforts to win this seat.

Peter, we’ll be honest with you: We’re confused as to why the GOP is so desperate to unseat Matt. Even his opponent made a donation to Matt’s campaign. And time and again, Matt has proven that he’ll ALWAYS stand up for the people of PA-08, Republicans and Democrats, fighting for our shared values in Washington.

Yet, the GOP wants to replace him with someone who will continue their chaotic and destructive agenda. No one should want to work this hard to undermine the American people, but here we are once again fighting back against these Republican tactics.

We need to show the GOP that they can’t buy this seat. While they’re spending millions on attack ads, lies, and high-profile visits from out-of-state politicians, our campaign is focused on real, grassroots efforts. Your donations help us combat their lies with the truth, hire more dedicated staff, and get the word out about Matt’s bipartisan vision for Pennsylvania.

Top GOP Leaders Are All In: Every major GOP figure has descended on our district to boost Matt’s opponent and rally their base. Apparently, they think a politician from Louisiana can understand and represent the interests of northeastern Pennsylvania better than Matt can. Super PAC Spending Is Skyrocketing:** A Mike Johnson-aligned super PAC is pouring even more money into this race than they did last cycle at this same point in the race, ramping up their efforts to win this seat. Peter, we’ll be honest with you: We’re confused as to why the GOP is so desperate to unseat Matt. Even his opponent made a donation to Matt’s campaign. And time and again, Matt has proven that he’ll ALWAYS stand up for the people of PA-08, Republicans and Democrats, fighting for our shared values in Washington. Yet, the GOP wants to replace him with someone who will continue their chaotic and destructive agenda. No one should want to work this hard to undermine the American people, but here we are once again fighting back against these Republican tactics. Kamala Harris misspoke during an MSNBC interview. Trump nonsensically ranted and babbled about buying furniture in North Carolina. Guess which one CNN and WaPo were harder on?

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93721595/501404063/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTU5MDQwNzQtZmE3Yy1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=8--Ty6jK6HdrEmcCrvB-Dx0RMGxDOSUxdKy5nnGQv2M=&emci=4eeb266e-fa7c-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=95904074-fa7c-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
_The Washington Post_ and _CNN_ again show the danger of the media’s obsession with covering politics in a “both sides” frame.
On Wednesday, Kamala Harris cited a statistic about the decline in manufacturing jobs under Donald Trump. Earlier in Pittsburgh, she cited the same statistic, using more precise language.
Here are the two statements side-by-side so you can see for yourself.
**MSNBC interview: **_“Even before the pandemic, he lost manufacturing jobs, by most people’s estimates at least 200,000.”_
**Pittsburgh speech:** _“All told, almost 200,000 manufacturing jobs were lost during his presidency, starting before the pandemic hit, making Trump one of the biggest losers ever on manufacturing.”_
The “mistake” here is barely perceptible, but Harris’ point is irrefutably true in both statements: Trump’s manufacturing record isn’t as strong as he says it is – he’s lying.
[**We’ll explain how _CNN_ and _The Washington Post_ responded to Harris’ misstatement in a second, but if you’re ready to support COURIER’s mission to call out the mainstream media for their double stand in covering Donald Trump, can you chip in $25 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93721597/501404066/-593472309?refcode=20240927-EM-FactCheck&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTU5MDQwNzQtZmE3Yy1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=8--Ty6jK6HdrEmcCrvB-Dx0RMGxDOSUxdKy5nnGQv2M=)
In response to Harris’ error, both _CNN_ and _The Washington Post_ went into full-blown, sirens blaring fact-check mode on Wednesday:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93721599/501404067/-593472309?refcode=20240927-EM-FactCheck&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTU5MDQwNzQtZmE3Yy1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=8--Ty6jK6HdrEmcCrvB-Dx0RMGxDOSUxdKy5nnGQv2M=)
**While they were running big headlines about Harris’ mistake, Trump was ranting and raving about buying furniture to a confused rally crowd in North Carolina.** It looked so bad, even _Fox News_ cut him off mid-ramble in their live coverage of the event.
The perils of buying furniture, immigrants eating pets in Springfield, giant faucets in California, Hannibal Lector, Trump’s insecurity about Harris’ bigger crowds, his hatred for Taylor Swift and Oprah – we could go on and on but here’s the point:
**At this point, Donald Trump misstating a statistic on his jobs record would be a massive upgrade compared to his incoherent, unhinged, and self-indulgent campaign.**
But legacy media like _CNN_ and _WaPo_ are afraid to say that too often and too loudly for fear of being accused of a left-wing bias that could hurt their profits.

By attempting to “balance out” the negative coverage between “both sides,” the legacy media only further legitimizes Trump and his anti-democratic candidacy. It’s partly why Trump was elected in 2016, and it could get him elected again in 2024.

clean_body: Kamala Harris misspoke during an MSNBC interview. Trump nonsensically ranted and babbled about buying furniture in North Carolina. Guess which one CNN and WaPo were harder on? Peter, The Washington Post and CNN again show the danger of the media’s obsession with covering politics in a “both sides” frame. On Wednesday, Kamala Harris cited a statistic about the decline in manufacturing jobs under Donald Trump. Earlier in Pittsburgh, she cited the same statistic, using more precise language. Here are the two statements side-by-side so you can see for yourself. MSNBC interview: “Even before the pandemic, he lost manufacturing jobs, by most people’s estimates at least 200,000.” Pittsburgh speech: “All told, almost 200,000 manufacturing jobs were lost during his presidency, starting before the pandemic hit, making Trump one of the biggest losers ever on manufacturing.” The “mistake” here is barely perceptible, but Harris’ point is irrefutably true in both statements: Trump’s manufacturing record isn’t as strong as he says it is – he’s lying. = In response to Harris’ error, both CNN and The Washington Post went into full-blown, sirens blaring fact-check mode on Wednesday: = While they were running big headlines about Harris’ mistake, Trump was ranting and raving about buying furniture to a confused rally crowd in North Carolina. It looked so bad, even Fox News cut him off mid-ramble in their live coverage of the event. The perils of buying furniture, immigrants eating pets in Springfield, giant faucets in California, Hannibal Lector, Trump’s insecurity about Harris’ bigger crowds, his hatred for Taylor Swift and Oprah – we could go on and on but here’s the point: At this point, Donald Trump misstating a statistic on his jobs record would be a massive upgrade compared to his incoherent, unhinged, and self-indulgent campaign. But legacy media like CNN and WaPo are afraid to say that too often and too loudly for fear of being accused of a left-wing bias that could hurt their profits. By attempting to “balance out” the negative coverage between “both sides,” the legacy media only further legitimizes Trump and his anti-democratic candidacy. It’s partly why Trump was elected in 2016, and it could get him elected again in 2024. Here at COURIER, we’re not afraid to call out the media. We’re also not afraid to tell the truth about Donald Trump and his threat to American Democracy. Austin American-Statesman -- Opinion: Cherish your vote and our democracy. Both face new challenges in Texas. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=092724_2&amount=25]
Team,
There's no way to sugarcoat this: A major party is advocating for a constitutional change in Texas that would codify their power and control into the state constitution. From the Austin American-Statesman:
" The Texas Republican Party platform now calls for a state constitutional amendment to create another requirement for winning statewide office: In addition to winning the most votes statewide, a candidate would have to win a majority of the votes in a majority of Texas’ 254 counties. "
This would create a mini-Electoral College just within Texas itself, with one vote for each county. Harris County, home to Houston and nearly 5 million people, would count exactly the same as Loving County, whose population during the 2020 census was recorded as 64 people .
For example, Texas' current governor won reelection with only 55% of the popular vote but "won" 235 counties. This constitutional amendment, if passed, would guarantee no other party could win a statewide election without taking away all those rural, deeply conservative counties. Opponents of voting rights want to use land, not people, to keep themselves in power permanently.
They're openly advocating for anti-democratic rules to limit the impact of people's votes just because they want to stay in control, Team. | Dear Fellow Patriot,

My name is Dr. Ben Carson, and along with my wife, Candy, I have spent years contemplating the challenges facing American families today.

Our new book, _The Perilous Fight_ , addresses these issues head-on, offering practical insights and solutions to restore and strengthen the family unit.

Why is this important? Because the family's pivotal role in our society is under threat, and without addressing these challenges, our foundational values may be lost. Hi, it's Tobias Read, I’m running for Secretary of State in Oregon.
This is important, so I’ll cut right to the chase: In just three days, my team will face our very last end-of-quarter fundraising deadline before Election Day — the biggest test we’ve faced yet.
With a dangerous MAGA extremist running to be Oregon’s next Secretary of State, we can’t afford to play it safe. That’s why I’ve set a goal to raise $5,000 before the end of the month, and I’d be grateful if you could chip in $5, $10, or more right now to help my team meet it before time runs out. >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=240927em-eom1]
DONATE NOW >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=240927em-eom1]
I don’t like coming to you for money if I can avoid it.
But the simple truth is that my opponent and his supporters know they can’t win this election on the strength of their ideas or the popularity of their agenda — so they’re trying to buy their way into office instead.
The best way to fight back against MAGA mega-donors is by chipping in whatever you can spare to grassroots-powered campaigns like mine — and with our last big fundraising deadline before Election Day just around the corner, your support has never been more important.
So please, can I count on you to chip in any amount before time runs out on our last end-of-quarter fundraising deadline of the election and help close the gap on our $5,000 goal? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=240927em-eom1]

Tobias Read

On November 10, 2022, I decided to share something very important to me on my social media--my IVF journey. As a content creator, so much of my life is already public, but I made the conscious decision to share this story because I felt that by doing so, we could continue on the path to normalizing conversations about reproductive freedom. Now as a candidate for US Senate in Utah, I want to continue this conversation.
Personally, my journey was difficult. I had a late-night unplanned ER visit because my ovaries were the size of a grapefruit and an apple (when they should've been around 2 cm) and a tough post-retrieval phase. While I'm glad I did it for peace of mind, it was a process that drained me, not just physically but mentally and emotionally.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/65b4b0f1-2df5-47a2-a4f7-a6ac1dd061bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Having, not having, trying, having difficulties, receiving medical help--everyone's journey in this process is different and completely valid. I'm unbelievably lucky to have had the opportunity to freeze my eggs and think longer about having children, and I know that we could benefit so much as a nation by doing away with ideas of what parenthood "should" and "shouldn't" look like and what we "can" and "cannot" talk about. No one should have to feel alone in this journey or feel shame or embarrassment about their situation. Families deserve the freedom to decide when and how they want to start a family . This is a deeply emotional process and changing our outlook can help so many people.
There is so much tied up in the possibilities of what can be, what can go wrong, what might change from the life I have now, and what realizing my dream of having a family will be like. The uncertainty of the future forced me to think about things from a different perspective, and what I've come to accept is that there will be great joy and regret either way. There are so many paths that I could've taken, but what's comforting is seeing friends with their children and older folks happy without kids. It's painful and tragic and wonderful all at the same time.
**That's why it's difficult when I see politicians debate our humanity in Congress.** Our reproductive rights have been weaponized as a political issue for years and serve as a jumping-off point for our government to extend their reach further into our daily lives and tell us what we can and cannot do with our own bodies.
My opponent has said: "I wish, as a man, I didn't have to make this decision; I wish women could make this decision." He celebrated the overturning of Roe v Wade and then voted against the Right to Contraception Act in 2022.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/95a4bd3c-887b-4f6c-bdb7-0a41e75a8bb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Members of Congress are known for being out-of-touch, but when they're clueless to the fact that they represent men and women who are choosing to start families with procedures like IVF, families who need abortions due to complications, and women who have the right to decide what's best for them--it's time to put politics aside and elect leaders who really understand what we're going through.
Having experienced what I have, it's impossible for me to judge someone's choices or actions regarding fertility and having children. I can only support them as a fellow person who's thought about starting a family, as a fellow woman who understands the struggles of living up to expectations, and in the future, as their United States Senator.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b85d6f74-a7e9-46ee-82bf-8d8659b7dfb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We all share a common vision for Utah, one of prosperity, hope, and progress--that's why I'm asking for your support. Your donation can help us turn this vision into reality, and together, we can make real, meaningful change. We have just 40 days until our election, so let's get to work. **[Please consider chipping in what you can today.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e7d6fd40-84ae-4588-bbae-040ce92aca2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ DONATE](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e7d6fd40-84ae-4588-bbae-040ce92aca2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you so much,
Caroline Gleich 🏔️
_P.S. No matter what you are going through or where you are in your fertility or family planning journey, know that I see you, I support you, and that you are a warrior._ ❤️

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 9/27/2024
body:
‘Not the gold standard, a bit of fool’s gold’: Ganahl finds areas of election concern which must be addressed before Nov. 5
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)Hello friends,

Yesterday I held a press conference about an important project I’ve been working on with a group of incredible volunteers. While running for Governor in 2022, I realized the lack of trust our citizens had for our voting systems -- 25% of Republicans did not vote in that election in Colorado as a symptom of that. I wanted to do something to restore trust in our elections, and find out what the TRUTH was, so we launched an audit focused on Douglas County, my home. ****
****
**What we found is troubling – our voting systems DO indeed have wireless remote access, our post offices are NOT held accountable for thousands of undeliverable ballots in 11 key counties that were “missing” ([Bob Cooper wrote about this months ago](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)) and our drop boxes are vulnerable as they are not effectively monitored. **

This is not the entirety of it and I will continue to share our findings as we continue to dig in! [Watch the press conference here.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) It’s 17 minutes, but incredibly important information for voters in Colorado. I include solutions to fix the problems we uncovered. If you would like to volunteer to help us, please email [heidi@theroadtored.com](mailto:heidi@theroadtored.com). Thanks!
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, September 27, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[‘Not the gold standard, a bit of fool’s gold’: Ganahl finds areas of election concern which must be addressed before Nov. 5](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Lengthy analysis and research into one county’s 2022 election results has brought up some significant concerns, Heidi Ganahl, the Republican candidate for governor in 2022, announced Thursday in a press conference.
“I’m concerned that Colorado’s elections are not the gold standard as proclaimed,” Ganahl said, “but a bit of fool’s gold.”
She is the founder and president of Rocky Mountain Voice, and a noted advocate for free and fair elections.
“Verifying the integrity of election systems is not the exclusive role of law enforcement, but the right and duty of the citizens, and the delegated responsibility of our legislature and our election officials,” Ganahl said. “It’s important the citizens of Colorado hear what I’ve learned.”
Her findings have led her to potentially litigate on behalf of Coloradans against the secretary of state, although Ganahl indicates she would seek other remedies.
Ganahl points to outcomes in Douglas County during the 2022 election, during which her name appeared on the ballot.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[A race with no candidate: 7th Judicial District attorney Seth Ryan withdraws](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* 7th Judicial District Attorney Seth Ryan, a Republican, is resigning due to a national shortage of attorneys and personal and political reasons, effective October 31.
* Ryan's resignation comes as he faces challenges in hiring and retaining qualified staff, with a turnover rate in his office reaching 56% in 2024.
* Although Ryan's name will remain on the ballot for the upcoming election as it was certified prior to his resignation announcement, the Colorado Republican Party may nominate a replacement whose votes will count towards Ryan's.
No Democratic candidates are running for the position, and ballots have already been printed and distributed to military and overseas voters as of September 21.
* Ryan cites the strains on his physical and mental health exacerbated by the COVID pandemic and the current political climate as additional reasons for his decision to step down.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

**[In run for state board of education, Yazmin Navarro calls for more voter interaction, education and assistance](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Yazmin Navarro, Republican nominee for Colorado’s 8th District state board of education, draws on her diverse experience in education, both in the U.S. and abroad, to advocate for better voter engagement among Republicans.
* Navarro has observed Democratic efforts in voter registration at events like a Latino festival in Brighton and expresses a desire for Republicans to enhance their registration drives. She emphasizes the importance of making ballot initiatives understandable to voters, suggesting that simpler language could help people better understand their choices.
* Navarro's campaign interactions have reinforced her belief in the importance of school choice and parental rights in education.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado Springs man sues Rep. Elisabeth Epps, attorney general for blocking him on X](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Michael Freeman is suing Colorado State Rep. Elisabeth Epps and Attorney General Phil Weiser, claiming Epps blocked him on social media (X, formerly Twitter) in violation of his First Amendment rights after a disagreement over legislative content.
* Freeman argues the block was part of Epps' official duties as it related to her legislative work, and thus illegal under recent Supreme Court decisions regarding public officials' interactions on social media.
* The lawsuit seeks monetary damages for the claimed violation, arguing it caused Freeman stress and anxiety, and demands that Epps unblock him to restore his ability to engage in public discourse.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[El Paso County Board of Health takes a stance on recreational marijuana ballot measures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The El Paso County Board of Public Health opposes a ballot measure to allow medical marijuana dispensaries in Colorado Springs to sell recreational marijuana, citing public health risks to youth.
* The Board supports a countermeasure to ban recreational marijuana sales in the city's charter, aligning with health data indicating potential harms from marijuana use.

The battle for the Senate is in high gear and the outcome will have major implications for our nation irrespective who wins the White House. Here's an update on eight of the top U.S. Senate races: **TEXAS **– Senator **Ted Cruz** (R) faces Congressman **Colin Allred** (D) who is backed by a mountain of liberal cash. Senate Democrats named Cruz as their #1 Target to flip a state from red to blue. A recent Emerson College poll shows that Allred's cash has pushed him to within 4 points. Now Ted Cruz is out with TV ads that expose how Colin Allred voted against a bill to keep boys out of girls' sports. **MONTANA** – Ex-Navy SEAL **Tim Sheehy** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jon Tester** (D) in the race that could strip the Democrats of their majority. Tester is the #1 recipient of lobbyist money and he's been a rubber stamp for the Biden-Harris agenda. Tester has tricked Montana voters for years, but they aren't being fooled this time. The Real Clear Politics polling average has Sheehy leading Tester by 5 points, which has Democrats on high alert. **WISCONSIN** – Businessman **Eric Hovde** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Tammy Baldwin** (D) in a presidential battleground state. Unlike many vulnerable Democrats running this year, Baldwin has actually embraced Kamala Harris and her extreme positions. Despite being attacked with millions on the other side, Hovde is exposing Baldwin's record and making the case for change. He trailed by 8 points back in June, but cut Baldwin's lead down to 4 points. **NEVADA** – Combat Army veteran **Sam Brown** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jacky Rosen** (D). Brown nearly burned to death after he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban, and his vehicle hit a roadside bomb. But after 3 years and 30 surgeries, he recovered and is now running for the U.S. Senate. Brown trails Rosen by single digits according to recent polls, but the race will tighten as Brown spends his war chest and voters learn about the choice they have in this race.

A recent poll shows Scott leading by 3 points, but he's out swinging – exposing how "Socialist Debbie" backs higher taxes on Florida families while giving tax breaks to illegal immigrants. **OHIO** – Businessman **Bernie Moreno** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Sherrod Brown** (D) in the most expensive Senate race in the nation. Progressive donors are pouring money into the Buckeye State to save their favorite liberal. Sherrod Brown featured a Republican in a TV ad who supports him, but the man is actually a Democrat. This is what Moreno is up against – lies, lies, and more lies – yet he only trails Brown by 3 points. **MISSOURI** – Senator **Josh Hawley** (R) faces Marine veteran **Lucas Kunce** (D) who is pretending to be a centrist. In a recent debate, Kunce refused to say if he was going to vote for Kamala Harris for President, which is laughable given his liberal record. The fact that he would try to hide his support for Harris shows what low regard he has for Missouri voters. Recent polls show Hawley with the lead, but he's being outspent 2-to-1, so conservatives can't sleep on the race. **ARIZONA** – Former TV news anchor **Kari Lake** (R) is taking on Congressman **Ruben Gallego** (D) to fill the open seat held by retiring Senator Kyrsten Sinema (I). Gallego is one of the most liberal politicians in Congress – even to the left of Nancy Pelosi. Gallego voted against border security while voting to give voting rights to illegal immigrants. Peter,
As the State Senator of Uvalde, Texas, I have seen firsthand the terror caused by unfettered access to guns. A teenage gunman in my district killed 19 children and two teachers, holding off law enforcement for 77 minutes because they were scared of his AR-15.
From day one, the Biden-Harris Administration has worked tirelessly to end senseless acts of violence, establishing the Office of Gun Violence Prevention one year ago to end this terrible epidemic. Here’s what we’ve accomplished:
✅ [https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcReR9TxzrxHLCKqQ1lGBa3stvPlld0z8eWw2_1FFToP4c4mvBAYY7pu9pAPW4sX4ZoZ8b5jS5QcKrsXG0fVTpHAceKQiQjGj5cQszoOTCaZNM6dGiTLRratLETbPI7-_pVV6_7fFzT0Ml__8t6aiOxR1M?key=DQtIZ05eHa2j56-M5nCmKg] Enacted the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act into law, the most significant gun safety legislation in nearly 30 years.
✅ [https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcReR9TxzrxHLCKqQ1lGBa3stvPlld0z8eWw2_1FFToP4c4mvBAYY7pu9pAPW4sX4ZoZ8b5jS5QcKrsXG0fVTpHAceKQiQjGj5cQszoOTCaZNM6dGiTLRratLETbPI7-_pVV6_7fFzT0Ml__8t6aiOxR1M?key=DQtIZ05eHa2j56-M5nCmKg] Expanded background checks, addressing dangerous loopholes and ensuring that firearms do not fall into the wrong hands.
✅ [https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcReR9TxzrxHLCKqQ1lGBa3stvPlld0z8eWw2_1FFToP4c4mvBAYY7pu9pAPW4sX4ZoZ8b5jS5QcKrsXG0fVTpHAceKQiQjGj5cQszoOTCaZNM6dGiTLRratLETbPI7-_pVV6_7fFzT0Ml__8t6aiOxR1M?key=DQtIZ05eHa2j56-M5nCmKg] Decreased mass shootings 20% and homicides 17% from 2023.
The Biden-Harris Administration is now working to assess and address the threat posed by machine gun conversion devices and 3D-printed firearms, and orders government agencies to create more effective and less traumatic active shooter drills for our nation’s children.
These actions will continue to save lives, but all of that could change if Democrats don’t win in November. We can’t forget how Donald Trump failed us on gun violence:
❌ [https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeNi3JaMcYrrgQe2N9fkjKOKuFs8PkcALwJreYwEmFmTJt0zeLQ7uS-EaBzrMFiEvmlXZjb7_uMeJ5RAr7rrJlxmMNqOpXjQRLkqpGRA7B-LYD6Q-Pgm8PXfXIMi9NjX_ptgGeyfDN883D3S6IJ6P49XP67?key=DQtIZ05eHa2j56-M5nCmKg] Gun homicides went UP 34 percent when Trump was president.
❌ [https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeNi3JaMcYrrgQe2N9fkjKOKuFs8PkcALwJreYwEmFmTJt0zeLQ7uS-EaBzrMFiEvmlXZjb7_uMeJ5RAr7rrJlxmMNqOpXjQRLkqpGRA7B-LYD6Q-Pgm8PXfXIMi9NjX_ptgGeyfDN883D3S6IJ6P49XP67?key=DQtIZ05eHa2j56-M5nCmKg] Trump told Iowans they “have to get over” the death of a 6th grader who was murdered earlier this year.
❌ [https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeNi3JaMcYrrgQe2N9fkjKOKuFs8PkcALwJreYwEmFmTJt0zeLQ7uS-EaBzrMFiEvmlXZjb7_uMeJ5RAr7rrJlxmMNqOpXjQRLkqpGRA7B-LYD6Q-Pgm8PXfXIMi9NjX_ptgGeyfDN883D3S6IJ6P49XP67?key=DQtIZ05eHa2j56-M5nCmKg] Trump has promised that he’ll “ terminate ” all the work we have done to save lives from gun violence if he becomes president again.

| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=52ddbf08c17947289756667c67aa7b81&_e=mFl1O2d7ppyhKFdjURm2M7W4xZHLR9mooRAnxpy-39PmDRdRveRKxsYdIbs4qXaqAc0rTZuA8E_mJnz7PiUAkX5_ciVy-kCnIXxZp4O4ihit6RWQnAn-nEKFF_hTOBAfoK1k2eS7eCn2DmnWQtNwsnEaBr6Zq_HIhlpgepwAwHtJ7TYrP2ZN4F1CfYgXZi8ut4qzf-6f8kyK3HtbcYGramvF7ezp7RKT_DRl3UoRC3W5JPd9ndbyDNtP4AX8RkrbEqG4ohPDD5MCeOH_LKjZEv_RH_NvsiMTdZl3NmJ2oQOXt_gGoVXqrfzAA8vMeDxut_e4JsH13-79IrImcY-lf06ixwtg7h7OoD0O73X2nrT8VQ3z_SeCTn1D3wzITa5c)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=52ddbf08c17947289756667c67aa7b81&_e=mFl1O2d7ppyhKFdjURm2M7W4xZHLR9mooRAnxpy-39PmDRdRveRKxsYdIbs4qXaqAc0rTZuA8E_mJnz7PiUAkX5_ciVy-kCnIXxZp4O4ihit6RWQnAn-nEKFF_hTOBAfoK1k2eS7eCn2DmnWQtNwsnEaBr6Zq_HIhlpgepwAwHtJ7TYrP2ZN4F1CfYgXZi8ut4qzf-6f8kyK3HtbcYGraqiFvi7-YYnoMFNetYT8asuu3gokcj5vQkmZbOSBoVM-6URP7ZsJOG6N6cswMSxVHsmwWRWjaTeiIkjWOrYXxVTP2dHAOlZe1qSq_UOUE9dVD0_vcaQcWUhRUWCnbPsz70lTW9PjPqml3cuAKuP3t2cr47s47oO7sWjojQ9RZQOV)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93727696/501421042/1135690821?refcode=AU_MKH_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20240927_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYTBkOTNiMC0wMjdkLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E1ebAaz-QgOdP1olPde4Uza0Twx8HZkkbGXk6_bfYF0=) Aloha Peter, It’s hard to believe it, but there are **less than 6 weeks until Election Day** — and that means I’m counting on grassroots supporters like you to step up and help me win re-election, protect our razor-thin Senate majority, and elect the Harris-Walz ticket this November. But before I ask for your support, let me explain why you’re guaranteed to make the greatest impact if you donate _right now:_
* It may not be November yet, but early voting _has already begun_ in several key battleground states. We all know this election will come down to a handful of undecided voters, and every dollar will help us reach them before they cast their ballots.

* As we speak, Kamala Harris and Senate Democrats are making their final TV ad reservations. By chipping in now, you can help them match GOP spending and keep their ads on the air for as long as possible.

**Let's do some digging on the Pro-RCV group here in Alaska. Disclaimer from their most recent newsletter.****The Pro-RCV group appears to be the “Dark Money” they were so worried about, Arabella Advisors and 1630 Fund are about as “Dark Money” as “Dark Money” gets.**_**Their new Incorporation is their top donor.**__**Then "Article Four from Virginia"**__**Then "1630 Fund in Washington D.C."**_
---
This is who is funding the [#RankedChoiceVoting](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66f7016b676fef597b9c3277&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fhashtag%2FRankedChoiceVoting%3Fsrc%3Dhashtag_click&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_66f6fdc6fb343212c65e44d0&l=en-US&s=ipwKF3Q9_e87pa2AkcS0wK6fde8%3D) group in Alaska 1630 Fund Swiss billionaire whose personal goal is to “(re)interpret the American Constitution in the light of progressive politics” has donated hundreds of millions of dollars to a left-wing group that is dumping millions into state ballot initiatives, a new report from Americans for Public Trust (APT) revealed. Hansjörg Wyss, through his Berger Action Fund, has donated $243 million to the Sixteen Thirty Fund, which “uses its war chest ... to support massive get-out-the-vote drives, issue advocacy campaigns bolstering President Biden’s agenda, liberal pet projects from abortion to immigration, and attack ads against Republican lawmakers,”
---
Swiss billionaire Hansjörg Wyss has been channeling substantial funds into American state ballot initiatives through the 1630 Fund aka Sixteen Thirty Fund, a progressive advocacy group.As reported by Americans for Public Trust, Wyss’s donations, which total around $243 million to the group, have been instrumental in influencing policies across various states, with a significant focus on Michigan. Since 2017, nearly $34 million has been funneled into Michigan to, among other goals, "rewrite the state’s election laws." This massive infusion of cash aims at bolstering liberal causes from immigration to abortion and enhancing Democratic voter turnout. Such activities have sparked controversy and legislative responses aimed at curbing foreign influence in American electoral processes.https://thefederalist.com/2024/04/18/dark-money-group-backed-by-foreign-billionaire-has-dumped-100-million-into-state-ballot-initiatives/1630 Fund is currently funding multiple ballot initiatives in Alaska, including Alaskans For Better Elections AKBE who brought Ranked Choice Voting to Alaska. Also including the recent push for a higher minimum wage. At some point, one must question when the regulators and government officials, elected to safeguard citizens, become tools manipulated by these malicious actors to act against the citizens they are meant to protect.(e.g. we have been attacked 4 times so far 3 times using state offices, we have been spied on, harassed, and our reputations damaged nationwide all because we were trying to address an election system we didn't feel was a good fit for Alaska)I hope you take this threat to your State Seriously, they are incredibly well funded and they are hell bent on making changes to the State of Alaska. This is one of those cases of too big to fail, where you will attack Alaskans and regular people, but applying these rules to a Swiss Billionaire is outside your job and expectations. As a citizen it saddens me to learn that millionaires and billionaires have more influence on a state and the way the state operates than the people who live here.Phil IzonPer State Statutes:**Sec. 15.13.068. # **JD Vance is Weird**
---
| | | | | [ ](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uwh16-f4d1ku-kyd76rh5/)
---
| | | | folks, Let's face it: JD Vance is weird. Saying that political leaders without biological children "don't really have a direct stake" in the country is outlandish, to say the least. His odd viewpoints alienate a significant portion of the population and raise questions about Vance's grasp on reality. The Democrats' new strategy of labeling Trump and Vance as weird seems to be working brilliantly. We have seen in the media that it frustrates opponents, leading them to amplify it further with their off-balance responses. So far, Trump and Vance have been incapable of finding an effective comeback, leaving them scrambling. Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz, a potential vice-presidential candidate for Harris, called Trump and Vance "just weird" in a recent interview. The Democratic Governors Association amplified this sentiment, spreading it across social media. Walz even referenced Trump's bizarre habit of mentioning the fictional serial killer Hannibal Lecter from "Silence of the Lambs" in his stump speeches, adding to the weirdness factor. Harris's campaign hasn't missed a beat in highlighting Vance's oddities. In a recent news release, they described Vance's out-of-touch ideas, particularly his stance on abortion and his comments about childless leaders. Harris allies, including Sens. Brian Schatz of Hawaii and Chris Murphy of Connecticut, have also chimed in, calling Vance's past comments "super weird." At her first fundraiser as the likely Democratic nominee, Harris herself called out Trump's "wild lies" and Vance's peculiar statements, reiterating that the only box to put them in is "weird." This new narrative has given Democrats a powerful advantage, one they rarely had when President Biden was still in the race. JD Vance's weirdness isn't a new revelation, either. While the majority of the public is learning who Vance is for the first time through these strange headlines, he has a history of making controversial remarks. In a 2021 interview, Vance slammed prominent childless Democrats, including Harris, as "childless cat ladies" with no stake in America. This comment alone is enough to raise eyebrows and question his judgment. Harris's quip in 2018, when preparing for a potential debate with Trump, sums it up perfectly: "Why are you being so weird? What's wrong with you?" Despite their attempts to flip the script, Trump and Vance have struggled. Trump spokesman Steven Cheung's attempts to redirect the weird label back at Harris and her allies have fallen flat. Donald Trump Jr.'s online rants about "soft on crime" politicians and Vance's reposting of videos criticizing Harris only highlight their desperation. In contrast, Democrats have masterfully co-opted Republican attack lines, using the "weird" label to their advantage. The Republicans' previous tactics of sharing clips of Harris's laugh or her stories have backfired, with Democrats now embracing these moments as in-jokes. The "coconut tree" anecdote has even become a symbol of unity among Harris's supporters. This new narrative has given Democrats a powerful advantage, one they rarely had when President Biden was still in the race. JD Vance's weirdness isn't a new revelation, either. While the majority of the public is learning who Vance is for the first time through these strange headlines, he has a history of making controversial remarks. In a 2021 interview, Vance slammed prominent childless Democrats, including Harris, as "childless cat ladies" with no stake in America. This comment alone is enough to raise eyebrows and question his judgment. Harris's quip in 2018, when preparing for a potential debate with Trump, sums it up perfectly: "Why are you being so weird? What's wrong with you?" Despite their attempts to flip the script, Trump and Vance have struggled. Trump spokesman Steven Cheung's attempts to redirect the weird label back at Harris and her allies have fallen flat. Donald Trump Jr.'s online rants about "soft on crime" politicians and Vance's reposting of videos criticizing Harris only highlight their desperation. In contrast, Democrats have masterfully co-opted Republican attack lines, using the "weird" label to their advantage. The Republicans' previous tactics of sharing clips of Harris's laugh or her stories have backfired, with Democrats now embracing these moments as in-jokes. If you’re like most conservatives, you get endless emails and text messages from candidates asking for money. _But how do you know if they are actually conservative and not just pretending?_ _How do you know if they even have a chance of winning?_ _How do you know if costly fundraising commissions and processing fees will consume most of your contribution?_ These are all important questions that everyone must ask if they want to be effective with their political contributions. **The Senate Conservatives Fund is one of the best ways to make your contributions count.** We do it by providing grassroots conservatives like you with a trusted list of candidates who are strong, viable conservatives. Every SCF-endorsed candidate must undergo a vetting process to help us determine whether they share our principles and values and, more importantly, will actually fight for them after the election. Every candidate must also run a professional campaign capable of winning. But creating a list of conservative candidates is just the beginning; we also give you an _**[_**effective way to fund their campaigns!**_](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=309aec8b66d14e23a33f5f261c4b9d63&_e=3WVxpAmG_ZsGCnXFGS3n4sQ3lT3ECDJZ3UOdPuaZydohmH7QQIlspR5rsPv-U1vxmsnUFNJKGiwK0osGTlC0U6JJbLDy5nmZyxZfot1XDPJLbSykv7_qOxCPezb4UVehcOXWJ4ZLctfeeEo0palJRwaGjdMwkblQQ4HIu6j0d29MDXUqABq6oG1cw8MGpzziVnMEHjsaRUg0HfCpoP2CLgIvDR4LCmfVvCc_U3Nfc3I%3D)**_ The best way to support a candidate financially is to donate to their campaigns. Once you move away from the candidate’s campaign — whether it be a party committee, joint-fundraising committee, PAC, or other organization — your contribution's effectiveness declines. However, donating to multiple candidates can be complicated and time-consuming, and there could be hidden fees and expenses that make this less beneficial to the candidates. **That's why SCF allows you to donate to multiple candidates with one payment and why SCF pays all fundraising expenses related to those contributions.** _This saves candidates a ton of money._ As you know, processing fees are charged for all online transactions. What you probably don’t know is that candidates also often pay steep fundraising commissions to third-party vendors, which are at least 80% of the value of your contribution. Candidates have to pay outside vendors to help them find new donors across the country, and this service is quite expensive. **That means that when you get an email or text message from a candidate and click on the link to donate $100 to that candidate, the candidate will often get less than $20 after expenses.** This is why you should [**donate to candidates through SCF**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=309aec8b66d14e23a33f5f261c4b9d63&_e=3WVxpAmG_ZsGCnXFGS3n4sQ3lT3ECDJZ3UOdPuaZydohmH7QQIlspR5rsPv-U1vxmsnUFNJKGiwK0osGTlC0U7A9AviZzZ13gNbVzHxJQXLzb9ShS2X4dmocptw07aSWmDOLHyKjEkx1_yxXc4jPw99fqC7nadZmLyljd3L-j6E2EjOhPTZwp_AEgFn-CeZFLjNWrOzZiIdb4zUXlLIrs57GVxraoknFsm1M8KRhEHY%3D) whenever possible. It’s one of the only ways to guarantee that the candidate will get 100% of your contribution with no hidden fees or expenses. And if you like our work and want to help us do more to promote good candidates, you can also contribute to SCF, which is our general fund. This will help us mobilize other patriots like you to help elect strong conservative leaders.

_**Congratulations Daniel Elliott on Being Elected as the next Secretary-Treasurer of the National Association of State Treasurers**_
---
---
|
---
The Indiana Republican Party is excited to congratulate Treasurer Daniel Elliott on his election as Secretary-Treasurer of the National Association of State Treasurers (NAST). This notable achievement highlights Treasurer Elliott's commitment to sound financial stewardship and his growing influence within the national fiscal community.

Since assuming office, Treasurer Elliott has demonstrated exceptional leadership in modernizing Indiana’s financial services, strengthening our investments, and ensuring the state's fiscal health for the future. His selection to serve in this important role by a bipartisan group of state fiscal officers speaks to his professionalism, expertise, and dedication to public service. We are confident that he will bring the same high standards to this national position that he has upheld here in Indiana.

Treasurer Elliott’s new role within NAST presents an opportunity for him to contribute to advancing responsible financial practices across the country, while also showcasing the strong fiscal management that has become synonymous with Indiana. His election is not only a recognition of his own leadership but also a reflection of the state's ongoing commitment to integrity, transparency, and innovation in public finance.

We are proud to see Treasurer Elliott represent Indiana on this national stage, and we are confident that his contributions will have a positive impact, not just for Indiana, but for state treasuries across the country. We congratulate him on this well-deserved election and look forward to the continued success and leadership he will bring to NAST and beyond.

_**Mike Braun’s Health Care Plan For Indiana!**_
---
---
Below are highlights from the Freedom and Opportunity Agenda - Health Care Plan For Indiana
---
1) Improve Quality
* Indiana ranks among the most expensive states for health care. At the same time, Hoosiers contend with poor outcomes for key metrics including life expectancy, heart disease, and infant and maternal mortality.
* **Mike Braun's plan** will concentrate on improving outcomes for Hoosier patients in the areas that will directly improve their lives using data and prioritized relationships with primary care providers.

2) Lower Costs
* For years, Hoosiers have contended with higher-than-average health care costs.
* **Mike Braun's plan will** lead a comprehensive approach to increase options for employer-sponsored health coverage, and continue to focus on surprise medical bills, rising drug costs, and long term care for our aging population.

3) Enhance Transparency
* For decades, the health care sector has operated behind a shroud of secrecy, with little to no price transparency. In the absence of transparency, prices have continued to rise at the expense of patients, employers, and the government.
* **Mike Braun's plan will** adopt sweeping price transparency legislation to empower patients with prices that are predictable, accessible, and useful and that nudge our health care sector towards the free market.

4) Expand Access
* No Hoosier should question whether they or their loved ones will be able to access affordable health care, including Hoosiers with preexisting conditions.
* **Mike Braun's plan will** enact solutions that increase access to healthcare for all Hoosiers, including those in rural areas, by embracing technology, supporting local providers, and empowering patients.

5) Promote Wellness
* Wellness can play an important role in the daily lives of Hoosiers to help them stay in shape, mitigate stress, and reduce their reliance on medical interventions in the long run.
* **Mike Braun's plan will** prioritize wellness through access to preventative care and screening while pursuing policies that encourage Hoosiers to live healthier lifestyles.

6) Increase Competition
* Hoosiers contend with a consolidated health care industry, which has created higher costs and fewer choices.
* **Mike Braun's plan will** cut red tape and remove barriers to entry, ensuring Hoosiers aren’t harmed by consolidation or overregulation.

---
_**Mike Braun issued the following statement upon releasing his Education Plan For Indiana:**_
_"As a Main Street Entrepreneur who took on rising healthcare costs in my own business, I know firsthand that the high cost of healthcare is a glaring weakness when it comes to attracting new companies and new residents, along with the burden on hardworking Hoosiers and business owners. Solutions such as transparency, innovation, competition, and empowering consumers are not hard to figure out, and I will provide the leadership required to deliver solutions to lower the cost of healthcare for Hoosiers." - Mike Braun_

Mike Braun's plan will concentrate on improving outcomes for Hoosier patients in the areas that will directly improve their lives using data and prioritized relationships with primary care providers. 2) Lower Costs For years, Hoosiers have contended with higher-than-average health care costs. Mike Braun's plan will lead a comprehensive approach to increase options for employer-sponsored health coverage, and continue to focus on surprise medical bills, rising drug costs, and long term care for our aging population. 3) Enhance Transparency For decades, the health care sector has operated behind a shroud of secrecy, with little to no price transparency. In the absence of transparency, prices have continued to rise at the expense of patients, employers, and the government. Mike Braun's plan will adopt sweeping price transparency legislation to empower patients with prices that are predictable, accessible, and useful and that nudge our health care sector towards the free market. 4) Expand Access No Hoosier should question whether they or their loved ones will be able to access affordable health care, including Hoosiers with preexisting conditions. From a young age, watching my mother face incredible challenges as she fought to make a life for us shaped my commitment to fighting for justice and being the voice for the most vulnerable in our community.

**Dear Fellow Americans**
This year's Federal and State elections are crucial to the future of our Country and Connecticut.
For many years politics has been a spectator sport for many Republicans. We have our wins and we have our losses. Yet life goes on and bad things don't happen.
This year is different. Our country and our state is at a crossroads and for some things we are at the point of no return if we do not change course.
Under Biden, Harris and Himes the last three and one half years have been a disaster. They created an artificial energy crisis that doubled and sometimes tripled our gasoline and heating oil prices. Natural gas is way up and Federal Laws prevent us from increasing our supply of inexpensive and plentiful domestic natural gas.
Inflation is the worst in decades. Together the high gas and oil prices combined with inflation has made life unaffordable for many Connecticut residents. Despite these economic burdens Connecticut through the public benefit fund of our electric bills is making matters even worse. The Democrats will not schedule a special session of the legislature to deal with this issue. This is the arrogance and indifference that the Democrats have toward the citizens of Connecticut.
Our border has been open season for up to 20 million migrants, including criminals, terrorists, drug dealers, slave traders (child and sex traffickers) and economic migrants who are being subsidized to a cost of 5% of the state budget plus local education and other expenses. The are the major cause of violent crime.
Our schools have turned into indoctrination centers.
Our society has been polarized by hateful antisemitism. Hiring is being based on Diversity Equity and Inclusion criteria rather than merit.
Local control of housing is being taken away by the state through 8 30G and Transit Oriented Development.
Our water company is on the verge of being sold to an agency that does not have to pay real estate tax and is not subjected to regulatory oversight.
Our towns will be irreversibly changed and will never be the same unless we stop it.
Our predecessors fought a Revolutionary war where they risked, their lives and fortunes to overturn an oppressive government. Many generations of soldiers have fought in wars to preserve our democratic way of life.
We do not have to risk our lives or fortunes to fight the oppression and socialist changes that Harris and Himes want to impose upon us nor the destructive changes that Hartford wants to impose on our town.
What is required of us is so much less. There are three things that all Republicans should do to save our country and our state.
1. Volunteer your time to help a Congressional or State Campaign or both.
2. For my campaign which is not funded by the state we need donations,
3. Go to the polls and vote
I am asking all of you to take these three steps to preserve our democracy
Thanks
Michael Goldstein for Congress

subject: In THREE DAYS the US Government...
body:
We have just three days to build up critical resources for my campaign! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=12c78bd4c6)

| |
---
| Peter,

Now is the time.

In THREE DAYS the US government requires us to officially report our 3rd Quarter fundraising total to the Federal Election Commission. (FEC)

In just 3 days our fundraising total will be analyzed and discussed by the media, who is not always friendly towards us, by the Democrat Party with their big bullhorn, and by my opponent who has been drumming out lies about my record.

What we raise NOW could determine victory or defeat in November.

We have three days to keep up my two point lead on Delaney. We have three days to keep my commercials on air. We have three days to fundraise and keep the momentum going into October.

As you read this, Mail-in ballots are being sent to voters all over Maryland. THE TIME IS NOW FOR ACTION.

I'm humbly asking for your support in this critical fight for the soul of America. Please send whatever you can to my campaign before our important deadline!

---

---
|
---
| Our country seems so divided right now, but I am actually excited.

Why? People seem to be waking up.
* People are frustrated that everything costs so much more than 4 years ago.
* People are skeptical now that the Democrats are sounding more like Republicans in their campaign promises.
* People are nervous about the unimaginable number of people streaming illegally into our country every day. How can our tax money pay for the cost of social services of schools, hospitals, and housing?
* People feel the strain of the increase in local crime, and unfortunately, many know local people who have died from fentanyl.

If you know my background, you know that I am an Engineer by trade. I have literally been solving problems for decades! I’m ready to get to work solving problems in Washington NOW.

---

| But without your help, I'll never be able to defeat April Delaney and her millions in out-of-state donations from far-left money groups.

If she wins, she will represent us in Congress for many years to come. I know that I do not want that. She was appointed by Biden to be in his Department of Commerce - the very department that counted illegal aliens in the 2020 Census!

Please send your immediate help TODAY. We can win this.
* The latest polls have me UP TWO POINTS.
* Fox News says my race is one of five that will determine who controls the House. This will be one of the closes races in the nation!
* The National Republican Congressional Committee selected me as a "Young Gun," meaning a race that they believe we can win! Their help is crucial, but we must show that we are in a strong financial position.

Reaching the goal we have set for my final FEC end-of-quarter fundraising deadline and fully funding my campaign is an absolute necessity. We can't win if we don't.

Before the FEC deadline in just THREE DAYS, please rush a donation of $30, $60, $90 or any amount to my campaign.

Will you help? Our team is working hard, and the time is now.

Neil

clean_body: I've got some exciting news to share, Peter. This week, I introduced a new resolution in the House calling for comprehensive legislation to address forced migration and displacement. For too long, politicians have treated immigrant families fleeing desperate conditions as pawns in a political game—and pretended that our broken immigration system starts at the border. But as the co-founder of the Global Migration Caucus, I know that we can’t create an orderly and humane immigration system without addressing the U.S. policies that force many people from their home countries. = **= Peter, many of my Republican colleagues like to pretend that our immigration system starts at the border. But here’s the truth: until we address the policies that force people to flee their homes and countries in the first place, no amount of border security will fix this problem. Unfortunately, U.S. policies often contribute to the displacement of people from their homes. Our weapons are trafficked into Latin America, causing violence. Our broad sanctions often lead to local poverty and hunger. And our military interventionism often destabilizes democratic nations, creating chaos and oppression. That’s why our resolution calls for: More legal pathways for citizenship An orderly, humane, and stable immigration system Ending U.S. policies that displace people from their homes abroad Tackling the climate crisis alongside neighboring countries = Thank you, -Greg Greg Casar Congressman Texas Congressional District 35 P.S. - Can you join us in Texas to rally and register voters? | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. If Democrats can expand the map in these final weeks of the election and are in a position to gain a seat, it changes the game in huge ways and forces Republicans to reconsider their whole approach to this election. Five polls have shown Colin statistically tied with Ted Cruz, but Cruz has raised over $59 million from GOP mega-donors in hopes of reversing this momentum.= = Ted Cruz has spent his time in office pushing some of the most dangerous conspiracy theories and hateful rhetoric imaginable. He's out to make headlines for himself at the expense of actually serving his constituents. Cruz led the charge to overturn the 2020 election results and fueled the fire for the January 6 attack on our Capitol. And he's already signaled that he's not going to accept this year's election results if he doesn't like the outcome. Cruz also led the charge to overturn Roe v. Wade. While millions mourned the loss of their reproductive freedoms, Ted Cruz labeled the Dobbs decision "nothing short of a massive victory." The people of Texas deserve a Senator who will fight for their interests – and they will have that public servant in Colin Allred. He's a fourth-generation Texan, a former civil rights lawyer, and a Congressman who's consistently put people above politics. But Colin just can't win this without extensive grassroots support. He's counting on your help to reach voters in every corner of Texas, fight back against Ted Cruz's onslaught of TV attack ads, and finally give Texans the Senator they deserve. If we're able to protect and even expand our Democratic majority in the Senate, our movement can continue building on the historic progress it has already made to bring down costs, level the playing field for working families, and hold corporations accountable. = Onward, Ron | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll split your contribution instantly between Colin Allred and Ron Wyden: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | Paid for and authorized by Wyden for Senate. | This email was sent by Wyden for Senate P.O. The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** First Absentee Ballots in Voters’ Hands The deadline to register to vote in Indiana is Oct. 7, which means there’s a little over a week left to make sure your voice is heard in the 2024 General Election on November 5. To register or to check your registration status, For those requesting absentee ballots, the deadline to do so is October 25, and the ballot must be returned by November 5. In person absentee voting will run October 8-November 4. Of the total amount, $1.17 billion comes from annual losses in tax revenue. Other losses come from parents having to leave or miss work due to a lack of care or opting to leave the workforce entirely in order to raise their children as a result of the high costs associated with many centers. Due to this, Indiana’s economy and job market are both ranked at 27th in the nation, according to an article published by the , with little room for improvement until the state’s expansive childcare deserts are addressed by the Republican supermajority, which has avoided doing so for decades. Therefore, with the election swiftly approaching on November 5, we urge you to vote Democratic not only for yourself, but for the sake of your children, too. It’s time we not only invested in our state, but also its future. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. This week, State Affairs released comparing and contrasting the education platforms of Indiana’s gubernatorial candidates: Democrat Jennifer McCormick, Republican Mke Braun, and Libertarian Donald Rainwater.
