| Hello Friends,
Our team has been working hard around the clock to ensure we reach every voter to let them know that come November 5th- we will be ready!
But, we can’t do it without you. With October 26 officially starting early voting, this is a sink-or-swim moment for our campaign. Can we count on you to keep our momentum going?
* [Sign Up Here to get postcards- we have five designs! ](https://daveforupstate.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=693154998c11c651b6b1b4c5d&id=f081a0ab05&e=fe1af7e622)

* [Sign Up Here to phone bank on your own schedule- we provide training and scripts](https://daveforupstate.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=693154998c11c651b6b1b4c5d&id=47c6ff2885&e=fe1af7e622)[. ](https://daveforupstate.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=693154998c11c651b6b1b4c5d&id=02bb53ed89&e=fe1af7e622)It’s easy and convenient to do in the comfort of your own home!

* [Keep an eye out on our Facebook Events Page for upcoming canvassing and meet and greet events](https://daveforupstate.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=693154998c11c651b6b1b4c5d&id=3f4d75fd84&e=fe1af7e622) (We will be in Niagara County the 29th, Geneva on the 30th and Batavia on the 5th!)

* [Or, if you can’t make a canvass launch, please consider signing up to canvass on your own schedule](https://daveforupstate.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=693154998c11c651b6b1b4c5d&id=bddcd32cd9&e=fe1af7e622)\- we will provide you walking lists and training material to talk to voters on your own or with friends!

We’re so grateful for all you have done to help us so far! Let’s work together to fight for a more affordable, fair, and bright future for our neighbors, families, and children.

I refuse to live in a state where women will die because politicians stake their claim on their most private decisions. **I refuse to stand by and allow Gianforte to deprive us women of our bodily autonomy, and violate our innate right to privacy.** Gianforte has signed every bill to take that right. If he wins again, Montana women will pay the highest price. During his time in Congress, Gianforte was a proud co-sponsor of the Life at Conception Act — the same bill that outlaws IVF and bans abortion with ZERO exceptions. If Gianforte will go this (_shamelessly_) far now, just imagine how much further he’ll go if he slithers by to re-election, Peter. **He’ll do everything in his power to enact full-blown Handmaid’s Tale, anti-choice laws right here in Montana.** I can’t help but feel overwhelming anger at the condition Gianforte has put Montana into. body:
We need to make this an earthquake election that Democrats never forget. | | |

body:
Highlights from UNT, UTD, Texas A&M, and more - your support matters
#
We wanted to share some exciting updates from Beto's recent tour across Texas college campuses. The enthusiasm we've encountered has been truly energetic!
Here are some highlights from our recent stops:
**University of North Texas, Denton:** We closed out a fantastic day with the amazing UNT students. The turnout was incredible, with many students getting registered and ensuring they're ready to vote.

**University of Texas at Dallas:** We kicked off the day at UTD with great optimism. Our wonderful Powered by People volunteers helped register and update registrations for hundreds of students.

**Texas A &M University:** We had a full day of adding new voters and updating registrations. Beto emphasized that young voters are key to victory, stating, "You've been counted out and written off for so long, they'll never see you coming!"

**University of Houston:** We also made a stop at UH, continuing our mission to engage and register young voters.

This campus tour is crucial as we approach the voter registration deadline in just 10 days. Beto is committed to visiting every major college campus to register as many voters as possible.

University of Houston: We also made a stop at UH, continuing our mission to engage and register young voters. This campus tour is crucial as we approach the voter registration deadline in just 10 days. Beto is committed to visiting every major college campus to register as many voters as possible. Every contribution, no matter the size, makes a difference in our efforts to build the largest voter registration effort Texas has ever seen. Thank you for being a part of this movement. Together, we're empowering the next generation of Texas voters and working towards a brighter future for our state. \- Team Powered by People Paid for by Powered by People, , not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee.

Friday, September 27, 2024 | Peter -- Welcome to our **Forward Friends** volunteer updates! Each week, we will cover campaign support efforts across the country to keep you informed, motivated, and connected as we work together to elect our Forward endorsed candidates. _Last Week’s Highlights:_ We are excited to report that we've had over 40 volunteers join our slack channel, and successfully onboarded about a dozen new volunteers to Call Hub. Thanks to your incredible efforts, we sent out over 6,500 texts to engage voters and spread the message of our Forward candidates. Your dedication is making a real impact! If you haven't gotten plugged in yet, you can start [here](https://home.forwardparty.com/volunteer_2024?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_pulse1&n=2). _A Heartfelt Thank You:_ A special thank you to everyone who attended our training session on the 18th. Your commitment to learning and growing as volunteers is what drives our movement forward. Together, we are building a powerful team! If you missed it you can watch the recording [here](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=kB45XuJbIaybua_uhXcc9p3GHOvxFcIOHqC8v0WARdbEgxY2j6iovIKkcljuGz8ZtyamC2L2rTDXP6p1CNd1IocY0LGj_A6BjUDiOnlD0qBDmIb-EJc_N7pT_HE79N_r&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_pulse1&n=3). _Upcoming Opportunities:_ Mark your calendars for our [Monday Night Madness](meet.google.com/ssu-wudq-uxd) text banking party every Monday at 8pm ET. This is a fantastic opportunity to connect with fellow volunteers, engage with our community, and make a difference. [RSVP](https://home.forwardparty.com/public_calendar?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_pulse1&n=4) to join us as we rally support for our candidates and share the Forward vision! _Candidate Spotlight:_ This week, we are thrilled to highlight Jonathan Duff, our candidate for Burington County Commissioner in New Jersey. Jonathan brings passion and dedication to the Forward Party and is committed to serving his community. He will be joining us at Monday Night Madness on the 30th, so don’t miss the chance to meet him and learn more about why he is running. Thank you for being an essential part of the Forward Party. Your efforts inspire us all to keep pushing. Let’s continue to make waves in our communities! Carrie Anne Templeton

Team Rosen, Donald Trump hosted a MAGA rally in Nevada to attack me by name and applaud my right-wing opponent, Sam Brown.

body:
On Friday, September 20, MAGA extremists on Georgia’s State Election Board voted 3-2 to require the hand counting of ballots cast on Election Day. | | | Peter, Last week, MAGA extremists on Georgia’s State Election Board voted 3-2 to require the hand counting of ballots cast on Election Day. **" 'Hazmat problem' causes shutdown on I-35 north of Dallas-Fort Worth,"** Dallas Morning News'**Aria Jones** -- "A "hazmat problem" led to closures on Interstate 35 north of Dallas-Fort Worth, near Valley View, officials with the Texas Department of Transportation said Friday morning.

As of about 9 a.m., only one lane was open in either direction.

A three-vehicle crash involving a rock hauler and passenger vehicle carrying radioactive medical dye prompted the call for a hazardous materials team to inspect the area, according to [emergency management officials](https://substack.com/redirect/aed7ff66-feb3-45d7-8125-3463cc9fb125?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Cooke County.

The outer container of one of the medical packages was opened though the interior packaging was intact, officials said.

**" 'Hazmat problem' causes shutdown on I-35 north of Dallas-Fort Worth,"** Dallas Morning News'**Aria Jones** -- "A "hazmat problem" led to closures on Interstate 35 north of Dallas-Fort Worth, near Valley View, officials with the Texas Department of Transportation said Friday morning.

As of about 9 a.m., only one lane was open in either direction.

A three-vehicle crash involving a rock hauler and passenger vehicle carrying radioactive medical dye prompted the call for a hazardous materials team to inspect the area, according to [emergency management officials](https://substack.com/redirect/1c3a7a57-8d6a-477f-8e65-c88e427aa3f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Cooke County.

The outer container of one of the medical packages was opened though the interior packaging was intact, officials said.

"Out of an abundance of caution, hazmat was called to assess the item," according to a social media post from the county officials.**** "The item was assessed and removed to a safe location."

The crash happened about 4 a.m. on the southbound side of I-35, near the Hockley Creek overpass, and involved three semi-truck trailers and a passenger vehicle. One of the trucks caught fire, and the driver died, officials said.

Our numbers are about to go public. Peter,

Now that we’re *officially* on the ballot for November’s election, it’s now full steam ahead until Election Day.

I’m proud to stand by my progressive record as a judge, city council member, and as the St. Louis County Prosecuting Attorney. I’ve worked tirelessly to put St. Louisans first, delivering real results and fighting for the people. **I can’t wait to get to Congress to keep fighting for your best interests at every level.**

St. Louisans have made it clear they’re ready to elect a for-the-people leader to represent them in Congress – someone who will really listen to their voice and make their concerns the priority. I’m so thankful for this grassroots team, for everything you’ve done to get us this far. But we can’t get complacent.

Now, we’re coming up against a critical FEC end-of-quarter deadline, and my team and I have set an ambitious $20,500 fundraising goal to keep our momentum going. I walked away from the Democrat Party because it is now led by people who reject the Constitution |
**We can't let the Democrat elite destroy America in the name of saving it, Fellow American.**

I walked away from the Democrat Party because it is now led by people who reject the Constitution, are undermining our freedoms, and willing to anything to stay in power.

As Democrats pushed policies that hurt our children, undermine our democracy, and pushed us to the brink of nuclear war, I could not stand idly by - I had to fight back!

That's why I left the Democrat party. I am a passionate defender of individual rights and our foundational principles of liberty, and will always put my country and the American people first.

That's why I'm campaigning with the NRSC in this critical election. The NRSC is supporting candidates in the most competitive Senate races nationwide. They are building a WINNING campaign to take back the Majority from Democrats who are destroying our freedom and leading us down a dark and destructive path.

Fellow Patriot,

I recently went to my home county fair, and it got me thinking about how the small town of Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania and the great people of my county helped shape who I am today.

_**I know this is a long message, but I hope you will read it all the way to the end.**_

Growing up, my family lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road.

I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms.

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=82b4906bd88f4d44b1dacac7b186f346&_e=O5mbIJwGXNvPmtbUbrJraWAXHkArhG1sKH3yfr0UdJ0tWq0T6_P1KeWQwEThFhVoNaB-eEKRYuO_Tok_HAnr0T-Ong849ybpwzdm6pcNf8ASuwrN1C5wH2IVeGc9ES0daxY7naUEP4U9wRdyxawm340-a4tDIye6dWnRtc1LpfLaaua7XH3mIoz-URBqyHES9-aHeNTKsg_RPCtxSQkU_dm9gbPa0n0ezSVtvXyFwLMvbHKyUxp1H-HVo4-JaqNh1tSlfqyI6JmO1sbl0WwzSJWGYltBbdmRKmB9_Tu9_wLsZ-eF8br21Oktxb0yXOMu_BTsdYpT0NypBbVni278XZNFEX9ogxSDCVx8g6uLEHiPv0YeDnpfHD04ZGIEaYpGq4QHiSZ9VHVbvtOJmC3Y2g%3D%3D)

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=82b4906bd88f4d44b1dacac7b186f346&_e=O5mbIJwGXNvPmtbUbrJraWAXHkArhG1sKH3yfr0UdJ0tWq0T6_P1KeWQwEThFhVoNaB-eEKRYuO_Tok_HAnr0T-Ong849ybpwzdm6pcNf8ASuwrN1C5wH2IVeGc9ES0daxY7naUEP4U9wRdyxawm340-a4tDIye6dWnRtc1LpfLaaua7XH3mIoz-URBqyHES9-aHeNTKsg_RPCtxSQkU_dm9gbPa0n0ezSVtvXyFwLMvbHKyUxp1H-HVo4-JaqNhsR8xVLXvWTVlt8J0g8fqMTd4LL2GBpd7wFo9mTZ0ny8K4hyPXbv63d1LO2tKDa-D5AuVXDN-mp95oA8jzOtOw4Z9rOVwEbGt4C57DcLGwOUNTklLJyRyJcndIF1XlqAaQpwNBHQ_7THQ1txk4h7Jzw%3D%3D)

My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh.

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=82b4906bd88f4d44b1dacac7b186f346&_e=O5mbIJwGXNvPmtbUbrJraWAXHkArhG1sKH3yfr0UdJ0tWq0T6_P1KeWQwEThFhVoNaB-eEKRYuO_Tok_HAnr0T-Ong849ybpwzdm6pcNf8ASuwrN1C5wH2IVeGc9ES0daxY7naUEP4U9wRdyxawm340-a4tDIye6dWnRtc1LpfLaaua7XH3mIoz-URBqyHES9-aHeNTKsg_RPCtxSQkU_dm9gbPa0n0ezSVtvXyFwLMvbHKyUxp1H-HVo4-JaqNhaNUQCMzR2hG-x4cyVrU7_KlWe3LQsGha-791Is-9t3b1ecTMpoTKi_SmQ3r2xF4ebmViK8Bj_q7lbvBKjRsQD4Y_ZIFo3eLNyRyg12edmAdszAxTxZghpNihxTs8f2oBQxXlwCFeA35YpsCY_Goy5Q%3D%3D)

I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg University) at only 34 years old.

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=82b4906bd88f4d44b1dacac7b186f346&_e=O5mbIJwGXNvPmtbUbrJraWAXHkArhG1sKH3yfr0UdJ0tWq0T6_P1KeWQwEThFhVoNaB-eEKRYuO_Tok_HAnr0T-Ong849ybpwzdm6pcNf8ASuwrN1C5wH2IVeGc9ES0daxY7naUEP4U9wRdyxawm340-a4tDIye6dWnRtc1LpfLaaua7XH3mIoz-URBqyHES9-aHeNTKsg_RPCtxSQkU_dm9gbPa0n0ezSVtvXyFwLMvbHKyUxp1H-HVo4-JaqNhZKXQFEAIYyQBnCm_fc5IcZbD5-2HGnjVdOR4pBBNHLRzTdRnVflMhB4RT5bo8YlBhuHqB7_TLHOMr8HVXkfvTNsd3ZqTnpUOkpEiqnpPkfAuqaz2F3i2LwcVY-KshcEkwFUhEccBTcAkuV8wqnPhkA%3D%3D)

I know this is a long message, but I hope you will read it all the way to the end. Growing up, my family lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road. I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms. My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh. I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg University) at only 34 years old. body:
We just got word that Republican election officials in North Carolina have purged more than 700,000 people from their rolls — nearly 10% of all registered voters.
#
Peter -
With 40 days until the election, this is not the news we were hoping to share.
**FIRST:** Trump set his attack dogs in Congress on the VA, subpoenaing them for registering Veterans to vote at VA facilities.
**THEN:** Trump launched his latest broadside against UOCAVA - the program Active Duty Military uses to vote overseas. He’s threatening to throw out their votes to “protect them.”
**NOW:** We just got word that Republican election officials in North Carolina have purged more than 700,000 people from their rolls — nearly 10% of all registered voters.
One thing is absolutely clear: We have to mobilize and fight back.
Trump made it clear that he aims to suppress the votes of Active Duty and Veterans this year. VoteVets is preparing our Veteran-to-Veteran texting program in response, and we’ll put a ton of resources into reaching hundreds of thousands of Veterans in swing seats and races we need to win this November.
**These programs aren’t easy, or cheap. So as we prepare one of the critical pillars of our outreach, we’re asking you for your help.**

name: Family Compassion
subject: Love Not Fear: Prayer & Worship for Springfield & Haiti
body:
Join us tomorrow in prayer...

https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_4jyOSBX6RkKMfa3NxMaBZg?amp_device_id=169aa2ea-35c3-44d3-8a59-da2e6df9a4f1#/registration

Dear Friends,

We invite you to join us for a virtual webinar, "Love Not Fear (https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_4jyOSBX6RkKMfa3NxMaBZg?amp_device_id=169aa2ea-35c3-44d3-8a59-da2e6df9a4f1#/registration) ” taking place on Saturday, September 28th at 3:00 PM EST.

This gathering is a response to the recent fear-driven attacks on the Haitian community in Springfield, which have deeply impacted the entire area. As people of faith, we come together with the belief that “perfect love casts out fear.” In the face of hatred, we choose love over retaliation, and unity over division.

This event is not just an emotional response—it is a theological declaration. The love of God compels us to reject fear, which fuels hatred, and to embody the radical love that Christ commands us to live out. If we claim to love God, we must love our neighbor—no exceptions.

At this gathering, we will:

- Pray for the Haitian community in Springfield, throughout the diaspora, and in Haiti.

- Pray for healing and reconciliation in the Springfield community.

- Pray for our nation, that our politics be rooted in love of neighbor, not in hatred or division.

- Pray for us to be better stewards of the Biblical command to welcome the stranger and care for the foreigner.

This is a time for reflection, prayer, and action—an opportunity to confront the fear in our communities and live out the love we are called to.

Event Details:

Title: Love Not Fear (https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_4jyOSBX6RkKMfa3NxMaBZg?amp_device_id=169aa2ea-35c3-44d3-8a59-da2e6df9a4f1#/registration)

Date: Saturday, September 28th

Time:3:00 PM EST

Location: Register on this Zoom link (https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_4jyOSBX6RkKMfa3NxMaBZg?amp_device_id=169aa2ea-35c3-44d3-8a59-da2e6df9a4f1#/registration)

We are honored to have the following speakers and leaders join us:
* Worship Leader: Elana Elmore, Central Christian Church
* Viles Dorsainvil, Pastor & Director, Springfield Haitian Community Help & Support Center
* Tony Iannetta, Silver Creek Church, Chair of the board of Community Life Centers of Haiti
* Troy Jackson, Chief Strategy Officer, Undivided
* Chelsea Sobolik, Director of Government Affairs, World Relief
* Dr. Christina Edmondson, Co-Host, Truth’s Table, Board Member, National Association of Evangelicals
* Rev. Dr. Gabriel Salguero, President, National Latino Evangelical Coalition
* James Talbert, Pastor, Citizens Akron
* John Max Lozier, Fuente de Salvación, Cleveland
* Natalie Runion, Founder, Raised to Stay
* Kirk Lithander, Global Outreach Pastor, Fairhaven Church

Please join us and share this invitation with others. Together, we can stand against fear and embody the love that brings true change.

In faith and solidarity,

Register Here (https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_4jyOSBX6RkKMfa3NxMaBZg?amp_device_id=169aa2ea-35c3-44d3-8a59-da2e6df9a4f1#/registration)

View email in browser (https://mailchi.mp/a653e8620c4a/love-not-fear-prayer-worship-for-springfield-haiti?e=43463f1dee)

This is a time for reflection, prayer, and action—an opportunity to confront the fear in our communities and live out the love we are called to.
